IBPS CRP PO MT XVI Mains Score Card 2026 Released For 7565 Posts

The IBPS CRP PO MT XVI Mains Score Card 2026 has been released on 27 November 2026 by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS). Candidates who appeared for the Probationary Officer (PO) and Management Trainee (MT) Main Examination under the Common Recruitment Process (CRP PO/MT-XVI) can check their available examination marks through the official website at ibps.in. The Mains examination was conducted on 4 October 2026, and the qualifying result was announced on 20 November 2026. Candidates can access the official scorecard login using the direct link provided below.

The IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 provides details of candidates' examination performance, including section-wise marks, overall scores and applicable qualifying cut off marks. The current score display is primarily for candidates who were not shortlisted after the Mains examination. Marks of candidates shortlisted for interviews are generally released after the interview process. The recruitment covers 7,565 vacancies for Probationary Officer and Management Trainee posts in participating banks. Candidates should download their available scorecards and verify the details carefully.

The IBPS PO/MT-XVI Mains Score Card 2026 download link has been published for the Main Examination. Candidates can check their available scores by accessing the official IBPS recruitment login portal and entering the required credentials.

The scorecard provides a detailed breakdown of marks obtained in the Mains examination. Candidates should use the login corresponding to the CRP PO/MT-XVI recruitment cycle rather than links for previous IBPS PO examinations.

IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 Release Date

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection released the IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 on 27 November 2026, following the announcement of the Mains qualifying result on 20 November 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination on 4 October can use the scorecard to review their performance.

The scorecard release allows eligible candidates to check their individual marks and compare them against the applicable examination cut off. Candidates shortlisted for interviews should follow the separate IBPS instructions regarding disclosure of their Main Examination scores.

How to Download IBPS CRP PO MT XVI Mains Score Card 2026?

Candidates can follow these steps to check and download their IBPS PO/MT-XVI Mains Score Card 2026 from the official examination website.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
  2. Click the CRP PO/MT recruitment section.
  3. Select Common Recruitment Process for Probationary Officers / Management Trainees-XVI.
  4. Find the link for viewing the scores of the Main Examination.
  5. Click the IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 link.
  6. Enter your Registration Number or Roll Number.
  7. Enter the Password or Date of Birth requested by the portal.
  8. Complete the displayed captcha or security verification.
  9. Submit the login details to access the available scorecard.
  10. Check your section-wise marks, overall score and applicable cut off details.
  11. Download and save the scorecard for future reference.

IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 for Qualified and Non-Qualified Candidates

The availability of IBPS PO Mains scores differs depending on a candidate's shortlisting status. IBPS generally releases the marks of candidates who were not shortlisted for interviews before disclosing those of candidates progressing to the next selection stage.

Candidate Category Scorecard Availability
Candidates Not Shortlisted for Interview Mains scores released on 27 November 2026
Candidates Shortlisted for Interview Marks generally disclosed after the interview process

Candidates who have qualified for the next stage should follow official IBPS notifications for the Personality Test, interview schedule and subsequent score disclosure.

IBPS CRP PO MT XVI Mains Result 2026

The IBPS PO/MT-XVI Main Examination Result was declared on 20 November 2026. Candidates were able to check their qualifying status through the official IBPS recruitment portal using their registration credentials.

The result indicates whether a candidate has been shortlisted for the next stage of recruitment, while the scorecard provides detailed information about marks obtained in the examination. Candidates should not confuse the Mains result status with the separate Mains scorecard.

IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 – Details Mentioned

After downloading the IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026, candidates should verify their personal information and examination marks. The following details may be displayed on the scorecard.

  • Candidate Name
  • Registration Number
  • Roll Number
  • Examination Name
  • Recruitment Cycle
  • Candidate Category
  • Section-Wise Marks Obtained
  • Overall Mains Examination Score
  • Sectional Cut Off Marks, Where Applicable
  • Overall Category-Wise Cut Off Marks
  • Other Score-Related Instructions

Candidates should retain a copy of their scorecard for future reference and compare their marks with the official qualifying requirements.

IBPS PO Mains Cut Off 2026

The IBPS PO Mains Cut Off 2026 represents the qualifying marks determined under the recruitment examination rules. Candidates may be required to meet both sectional and overall qualifying standards to progress to subsequent selection stages.

The applicable cut off marks can vary according to reservation category, available vacancies, examination performance and other recruitment criteria. Candidates should refer to the official IBPS score display and cut off information rather than relying on expected marks.

IBPS PO Mains Exam Pattern 2026

The IBPS PO/MT-XVI Main Examination assesses candidates across objective and descriptive components. The objective test includes reasoning, English language, data analysis and general or banking awareness, while the descriptive component evaluates English writing skills.

The section-wise marks, examination duration and evaluation conditions are governed by the official CRP PO/MT-XVI examination notification. Candidates should consult that notification when interpreting their scores or comparing performance across sections.

IBPS PO MT XVI Vacancy Details 2026

The IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI recruitment covers a total of 7,565 advertised vacancies for Probationary Officer and Management Trainee positions in participating banks.

Post Name Advertised Vacancies
Probationary Officer / Management Trainee (PO/MT) 7,565
Total 7,565

These vacancy figures relate to the recruitment cycle and should be distinguished from the number of candidates who qualified for the Mains examination or subsequent interview process.

IBPS CRP PO MT XVI Selection Process 2026

The IBPS Probationary Officer and Management Trainee recruitment involves multiple selection stages. Candidates must satisfy the eligibility, examination and selection requirements prescribed by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection.

  • Preliminary Examination
  • Main Examination
  • Personality Test, as applicable
  • Interview
  • Final Provisional Allotment

Candidates who are shortlisted after the Mains examination must follow the official instructions regarding the Personality Test and interview. Final provisional allotment is based on the applicable recruitment rules and merit calculation.

What After IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026?

The next step depends on whether a candidate has qualified for the interview stage. Candidates shortlisted after the Main Examination should prepare for the Personality Test and interview and monitor official IBPS announcements for further instructions.

Candidates who were not shortlisted can review their section-wise and overall marks to evaluate their performance. The scorecard helps identify areas where improvement may be needed for future banking examinations.

IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 Not Downloading?

Candidates who experience difficulty downloading the IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 should first verify that they are using the correct recruitment cycle and official scorecard login.

They should confirm their registration number or roll number and enter the required password or date of birth correctly. If the portal displays a technical error, candidates should check the official IBPS website for updated links or support instructions.

Candidates shortlisted for interviews should also note that the current score display may not be available to them until the applicable later stage of the recruitment process.

IBPS PO Mains Score Card 2026 Important Instructions

Candidates accessing their Mains examination scores should follow these important instructions.

  • Visit the official IBPS website for the scorecard download facility.
  • Select the CRP PO/MT-XVI recruitment cycle.
  • Use the correct registration number or roll number.
  • Enter the password or date of birth requested by the login portal.
  • Complete mandatory security verification.
  • Verify personal information and examination marks.
  • Check the section-wise and overall scores.
  • Compare marks with the applicable official cut off.
  • Download and retain the scorecard for reference.
  • Follow official announcements regarding the next recruitment stages.
  • Do not share passwords or sensitive login details with unauthorised persons.

SSC WR Telecom Assistant Rejection Reasons and Essential Qualification

Candidates were rejected after the User Department scrutinised the soft copies of their applications and supporting documents. Most of the printed reasons concern the essential qualification.

Essential Qualifications Prescribed for Telecom Assistant

The notices print the following essential qualifications for the post.

  • Minimum three years Engineering Diploma in Telecommunications or Electronics or Electrical or Electronics and Communications or Computer Science or Information Technology or Cyber Security and Big Data Analysis or Internet of Things(IoT) or Instrumentation from a recognized Institute or University; Or
  • Bachelor of Science in Electronics or Electronics and Communication or Computer Science or Information Technology from a recognized University or Institute.

Reasons for Rejection Printed in the List

The rejection list gives these reasons, among others.

  • The essential qualification is not matching with the Rectt. Rule.
  • The essential qualification is not available.
  • Essential qualification certificate has not been submitted / attached.
  • Degree certificate has not been attached and with the available marksheets stream is not clear.
  • Degree certificate is not visible properly.
  • Caste certificate and Degree have not been attached.
  • Candidate does not fulfills age criteria under SC category with admissible relaxation (Ex-Serviceman).
  • PwBD Certificate and essential qualification certificate have not been submitted.
  • Disability certificate issued after Crucial date.
  • Annexure -X(A) has not been attached.
  • Essential Qualification and EWS Certificate have not been attached.
  • Matriculation certificate has not been uploaded.
  • Candidate's name does not match with the application form.

What After SSC WR Telecom Assistant Eligible List 2026?

The candidates in the revised eligible list have been shortlisted for further stages of recruitment. The notices do not give the date or details of the next stage.

  • Eligibility is provisional, as shown in the "Status of Scrutiny" column.
  • SSC WR says it has scrutinised the representations against the tentative rejection list posted on 09.09.2026. Those representations were due by 16.09.2026 by e-mail to [email protected].
  • The rejection list notes: "Please note that no further representation against rejection from the candidates will be entertained by the commission."

Ramgarh Home Guard Dulmi and Mandu Re-medical Result 2026

Under Advertisement No. 01/2026, a provisional list of Dulmi and Mandu block candidates was made from their physical test marks, and they then had document verification and a medical test. In that medical test, 01 female candidate from Dulmi and 01 male and 02 female candidates from Mandu were found unfit.

Under memo No. 1293 dated 21.11.2026, these 04 candidates had a second medical test at Sadar Hospital, Ramgarh. The notice lists the candidates found unfit again, based on the report sent by the Deputy Superintendent, Sadar Hospital, under letter No. 1615 dated 24.11.2026.

What After Ramgarh Home Guard Result 2026?

Urban Technical candidates on the provisional list must attend document verification and medical test on 28.11.2026 at 11:00 AM (forenoon) at the DRDA Hall, Block B, Collectorate, Ramgarh.

Ramgarh Home Guard Urban Technical Provisional List

The provisional list is based on physical test marks and sports certificate marks, under clause 4 (iv) and (v) and notes 12, 13, 14 and 16 of the Jharkhand Home Guard (Volunteer) Rules, 2014.

  • Separate male and female lists give the serial number, roll number and category.
  • The full table for each candidate ends with the remark "Call For Document Verification".
  • Candidature may be cancelled if an error is found or the candidate is ineligible during DV and medical test. The District Selection Committee's decision will be final.
  • The District Selection Committee will publish the final merit list for candidates found eligible after DV and medical test.

Documents Required for Ramgarh Home Guard DV 2026

Candidates must bring these documents to the centre.

  • Original copies of all certificates
  • Aadhaar card / Voter ID card
  • Four colour photographs
  • Online acknowledgement (for entry)
  • Affidavit in the format printed in the notice

Ramgarh Home Guard DV Affidavit Format

The affidavit printed in the notice must state the following points.

  • The candidate is a local resident of the stated village, panchayat, block and district, and gives the current place of residence.
  • The candidate carefully read Advertisement No. 01/2026 and applied in their own block.
  • The documents and certificates submitted with the application are fully valid.
  • If any document is found invalid, forged or wrong at any stage, the district administration may cancel the appointment at any stage without notice and take legal action.
  • Roll number, place, date, and the signature and name of the person making the affidavit.

The KEA KSET Revised Result 2026 has been released on 26 November 2026 by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA). Candidates who appeared for the Karnataka State Eligibility Test (KSET) 2026 can check the revised provisional qualification lists and subject-wise, category-wise cut off marks through the official website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/kset2026. The revised results were issued after KEA identified a technical error affecting the allocation of reserved slots in certain Scheduled Caste sub-categories.

The KSET 2026 examination was conducted on 11 October 2026 across 37 subjects to determine eligibility for Assistant Professor positions in Karnataka. The original provisional results were announced on 20 November 2026, with 8,171 candidates as qualified. Following objections from candidates, KEA corrected the allocation of SCC(MB) category slots that had been mistakenly assigned to SCC(G) candidates. The revised result and cut off PDF is available through the link provided below. Candidates belonging to the affected categories should check their updated qualification status.

The Karnataka Examinations Authority issued the revised KSET 2026 provisional result notification on 26 November 2026. This update follows the original result publication on 20 November 2026, when the authority announced the provisionally qualified candidates across 37 subjects.

After the initial announcement, objections were raised regarding the allocation of reserved slots under certain Scheduled Caste sub-categories. KEA reviewed the issue, identified the technical error and released corrected subject-wise qualification lists.

How to Download KEA KSET Revised Result 2026?

Candidates can follow these steps to access the KSET 2026 revised provisional result and category-wise cutoff marks from the official Karnataka Examinations Authority website.

  1. Visit the official KEA website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/.
  2. Open the Karnataka State Eligibility Test (KSET) 2026 section.
  3. Find the link for the revised provisional results or updated subject-wise cut off marks.
  4. Click the relevant KSET Revised Result 2026 PDF link.
  5. Open the revised qualification report for the applicable subject and category.
  6. Check the category-wise qualification details and cutoff marks.
  7. Search for your application number in the relevant qualified-candidates list, where provided.
  8. Verify your updated provisional qualification status.
  9. Download the revised PDF and save it for future reference.

Why Was the KSET Result 2026 Revised?

The KEA KSET Result 2026 was revised after candidates belonging to the SCC(MB) category raised objections about the allocation of reserved qualification slots. Following a review, KEA identified a technical error that had resulted in certain SCC(MB) slots being incorrectly allocated to SCC(G) candidates.

The authority corrected the allocation and reassigned the affected slots to eligible SCC(MB) candidates according to merit. Consequently, the provisional qualification lists and cutoff marks for the affected categories were revised.

KEA KSET Revised Result 2026: Which Categories Are Affected?

The KSET 2026 revision primarily concerns the SCC(MB) and SCC(G) categories. KEA clarified that the previously announced provisional results for categories other than these two remain unchanged.

  • Category-wise cutoff marks
  • Qualified application numbers, where provided

Candidates belonging to the affected categories should download the updated qualification lists and verify their application numbers and cutoff marks. Those who are provisionally qualified should retain copies of their relevant result documents for further official procedures.

The revised announcement concerns provisional qualification. Candidates should continue monitoring KEA notifications for further instructions regarding the final result, eligibility certificates or any applicable verification requirements.

The official IBPS recruitment page lists the latest provisional allotment update dated 16 November 2026. Candidates should use the PO/MT-XV login link and not the separate Specialist Officers reserve-list portal.

How to Check IBPS PO 3rd Reserve List 2026?

Candidates can check the latest IBPS PO reserve-list provisional allotment by following these steps.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
  2. Open the CRP PO/MT section.
  3. Select Probationary Officers / Management Trainees XV.
  4. Find the link titled Provisional Allotment under Reserve List for CRP-PO/MTs-XV, dated 16 November 2026.
  5. Click on the provisional allotment result link.
  6. Enter your Registration Number or Roll Number and the other credentials requested by the portal.
  7. Complete the verification code, if displayed.
  8. Submit the details to check your provisional allotment status.
  9. Download or save the displayed result for future reference.

What Is the IBPS PO Reserve List?

The IBPS PO reserve list is maintained to consider eligible candidates for provisional allotment against vacancies remaining or subsequently by participating banks, in accordance with the applicable recruitment rules.

Candidates on the reserve list are not automatically guaranteed a bank allotment. Their selection depends on their merit position, category, preferences and the number of vacancies available during the relevant allotment round.

IBPS PO Third Reserve List 2026 - Provisional Allotment

The latest IBPS PO provisional allotment update concerns the CRP PO/MT-XV recruitment cycle. Candidates can check whether they have received an allotment through the official login portal.

The term provisional allotment means that a candidate has been allotted to a participating bank subject to eligibility verification and other applicable conditions. It does not automatically constitute a final appointment or joining order.

Details to Check in IBPS PO Reserve List Result 2026

After accessing the provisional allotment result, candidates should check the information displayed on the portal, which may include:

  • Registration number or roll number
  • Candidate's name, if displayed
  • Recruitment cycle
  • Category
  • Provisional allotment status
  • Participating bank allotted, if applicable
  • Important instructions regarding further recruitment formalities

Candidates should retain a copy of the result and follow the instructions issued by IBPS and the allotted bank.

IBPS PO Reserve List 2026 Selection Criteria

Provisional allotment under the reserve list is governed by the recruitment rules applicable to CRP PO/MT-XV.

The following factors are relevant to reserve-list allotment:

  • Applicable merit position under the recruitment process
  • Candidate category and reservation requirements
  • Preferences submitted for participating banks
  • Vacancies by participating banks
  • Fulfilment of eligibility and allotment conditions

IBPS may issue further allotment updates according to the recruitment rules and availability of vacancies. Candidates should rely on official notices rather than assume that additional rounds are guaranteed.

What After IBPS PO 3rd Reserve List 2026?

Candidates who receive provisional allotment should carefully read their result and follow subsequent instructions from the allotted bank.

  1. Download or save the provisional allotment result.
  2. Check the allotted bank, if one is shown.
  3. Monitor official communication from the participating bank.
  4. Prepare the required identity, qualification and category certificates.
  5. Attend document verification or medical examination if instructed.
  6. Complete further recruitment formalities within the deadlines specified by the bank.

The allotment is subject to verification and does not guarantee appointment without completion of the prescribed requirements.

Documents Required After IBPS PO Reserve List Allotment

Candidates provisionally allotted to a participating bank should keep the relevant documents ready, subject to the bank's instructions.

  • Provisional allotment result or communication
  • Application and registration details
  • Valid government-issued photo identity proof
  • Date of birth proof
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Category, EWS or PwBD certificates, if applicable
  • Other documents requested by the allotted bank

The exact document requirements and verification schedule will be communicated by the relevant participating bank.

IBPS PO 3rd Reserve List 2026 vs IBPS PO Mains Result 2026

Candidates should note that the reserve list released in November 2026 belongs to the CRP PO/MT-XV recruitment cycle, whereas the IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 being awaited for the current recruitment belongs to CRP PO/MT-XVI.

RSSB CET 12th Exam Dress Code 2026

The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board has prescribed dress-code and security instructions for candidates appearing in the CET Senior Secondary Level examination.

  • Wear simple clothing permitted under the examination dress code.
  • Avoid prohibited electronic devices and accessories.
  • Do not wear a wristwatch or smartwatch.
  • Do not carry mobile phones, calculators, Bluetooth devices or communication equipment.
  • Follow the security and identity verification procedures.
  • Check the detailed dress-code instructions published by RSSB.
  • Cooperate with examination-centre officials during frisking and biometric verification.

Candidates should follow the latest RSSB notice for specific clothing, footwear and accessory restrictions.

BHEL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

The educational qualifications differ between Engineer/Executive Trainee and Supervisor Trainee recruitment. Candidates must possess the prescribed full-time qualifications in the respective disciplines.

BHEL Executive Trainee HR Qualification 2026

Candidates must possess both of the following qualifications:

  • A full-time regular Bachelor's Degree from a recognized Indian university with at least 60% aggregate marks.
  • A two-year full-time regular postgraduate Degree or Diploma in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations, Social Work or an MBA, with at least 55% aggregate marks.

Candidates with postgraduate qualifications in Social Work or Business Administration must have studied Personnel Management, Labour Welfare or HRM as a specialization or elective in their final year.

BHEL Executive Trainee Finance Qualification 2026

Candidates must be qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) or Cost and Management Accountants (CMA) from institutions recognized by the appropriate statutory authorities in India.

A B.Com. degree alone does not satisfy the eligibility requirements for Executive Trainee (Finance).

Can Diploma Holders Apply for BHEL Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Eligible candidates with a full-time regular Engineering Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics or Civil Engineering can apply for the corresponding Supervisor Trainee positions.

However, the Engineering Diploma alone is not sufficient for the Engineer Trainee posts, which require an eligible Engineering Degree.

Can Final-Year Students Apply?

Yes. The notifications permit candidates in the final year or semester of their qualifying course to apply.

However, shortlisted candidates must provide proof of having passed the required examination by the document verification stage. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed certificates or marksheets by that stage will be disqualified.

BHEL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process is different for Engineer/Executive Trainee and Supervisor Trainee posts.

BHEL Engineer/Executive Trainee Selection Process 2026

Selection includes a Computer-Based Examination and interview.

  1. Online application and eligibility scrutiny.
  2. Computer-Based Examination (CBE).
  3. Shortlisting for interview in a 1:5 ratio, based on vacancies, discipline and reservation category.
  4. Personal interview.
  5. Verification of documents and eligibility.
  6. Final merit preparation and medical fitness assessment.

Selection Component Weightage

BHEL Supervisor Trainee Selection Process 2026

Supervisor Trainees will undergo a two-stage selection procedure:

  1. Computer-Based Examination (CBE).
  2. Document Verification / Scrutiny for shortlisted candidates.

Candidates will be shortlisted for document verification in the ratio of 1:3 based on their CBE performance, discipline, vacancies and reservation category.

Document verification is a qualifying stage. The final merit list will be based entirely on the CBE score of candidates found eligible during verification.

Important: Meeting the minimum qualifying percentage does not guarantee shortlisting. Actual interview or document verification cut-offs depend on merit and the number of vacancies.

BHEL Recruitment 2026 Posting and Transfer Conditions

Selected candidates will be posted to BHEL manufacturing units, Power Sector regions, project sites or other notified establishments according to vacancies and recruitment requirements.

Applicants must indicate their preferred units or sites while filling out the application.

Final allocation will depend on merit, preferences, reservation norms and vacancy availability.

Important Posting Condition: Selected candidates are required to serve at their allotted unit or site for at least 10 years from the date of joining. Requests for transfer or change of posting will generally not be entertained during this period.

BHEL Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

Eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official BHEL Careers portal.

Apply Online: careers.bhel.in

Registration Opening: 25 November 2026, 10:00 AM.

Registration Closing: 28 December 2026, 11:45 PM.

Applications through any other mode will not be accepted.

How to Apply Online for BHEL Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official BHEL recruitment website at careers.bhel.in.
  2. Find Engineer/Executive Trainee Recruitment 2027 or Supervisor Trainee Recruitment 2027.
  3. Download the relevant Advertisement No. 02/2026 or 03/2026.
  4. Read the detailed eligibility and selection instructions.
  5. Select the correct trainee position and discipline.
  6. Open the online application link when registration becomes available.
  7. Complete the registration process using a valid email address and contact information.
  8. Enter personal and educational details accurately.
  9. Provide academic marks or CGPA according to the official calculation instructions.
  10. Choose the applicable reservation category.
  11. Select the examination city preferences.
  12. Enter BHEL unit or posting preferences where required.
  13. Upload the prescribed documents, photograph and signature according to the portal instructions.
  14. Review all information carefully before final submission.
  15. Pay the applicable examination and processing fee.
  16. Ensure the payment transaction is successful.
  17. Submit the application by 28 December 2026 at 11:45 PM.
  18. Download or print the completed application and fee receipt.
  19. Monitor the BHEL Careers website and registered email for examination updates.

Important: Candidates should select the examination discipline and trainee position carefully. Applications containing incorrect category, qualification or identity details may be rejected.

Documents Required for BHEL Recruitment 2026

Applicants should keep the following documents ready as applicable:

  • Class 10 certificate for proof of date of birth.
  • Relevant Engineering Degree or Diploma certificates and marksheets.
  • Qualifying Bachelor's Degree certificates for HR and Finance Supervisor Trainee posts.
  • Relevant postgraduate Degree or Diploma certificates for Executive Trainee (HR).
  • CA or CMA qualification records for Executive Trainee (Finance).
  • Semester-wise marksheets and CGPA conversion proof, where applicable.
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, where applicable.
  • PwBD certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable.
  • Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable.
  • Valid photo identification.
  • Recent photograph and scanned signature in the required format.
  • No Objection Certificate, where applicable.
  • Online application confirmation.
  • Application and processing fee receipt.

Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents during verification. Candidates employed in Government departments, autonomous organizations or PSUs may be required to provide an NOC from their employer.

BHEL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • There are 415 vacancies across the two recruitment advertisements.
  • Engineer/Executive Trainee recruitment is covered by Advertisement No. 02/2026.
  • Supervisor Trainee recruitment is covered by Advertisement No. 03/2026.
  • Engineer/Executive Trainee vacancies total 200.
  • Supervisor Trainee vacancies total 215.
  • The application period is 25 November to 28 December 2026.
  • The tentative examination date is 27 January 2027.
  • Applications must be submitted online only.
  • Only full-time regular qualifications are accepted where prescribed.
  • Final-year candidates may apply subject to qualification proof at verification.
  • Age eligibility is determined as on 1 November 2026.
  • The application fee is Rs. 1,072 or Rs. 472 depending on category.
  • Engineer/Executive Trainee selection includes CBE and interview.
  • Supervisor Trainee selection includes CBE and document verification.
  • Supervisor Trainee final merit is based on CBE marks.
  • Engineer/Executive Trainee final merit gives 75% weightage to CBE and 25% to interview.
  • The examination for the same discipline in ET and ST recruitment is conducted on the same day.
  • Candidates can select up to five examination centre preferences.
  • Both trainee categories have one year of training.
  • The service bond period is three years excluding training.
  • ET candidates are subject to Rs. 5 lakh liquidated damages for early resignation.
  • ST candidates are subject to Rs. 3 lakh liquidated damages for early resignation.
  • Selected candidates must generally serve at their allotted posting for ten years.
  • Medical fitness according to BHEL standards is mandatory.
  • Candidates already selected/engaged in specified BHEL trainee or artisan positions, or serving on probation in BHEL, are not eligible under the stated conditions.
  • Candidates should regularly check the official careers website for changes to the recruitment schedule.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

NHPC Limited has released the NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification for 205 Trainee Engineer vacancies in Civil, Electrical and Mechanical disciplines through GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores. The recruitment includes 188 vacancies in NHPC Limited and 17 vacancies in NHDC Limited, a joint venture of NHPC and the Government of Madhya Pradesh. Candidates possessing a full-time Engineering Degree in the prescribed discipline with at least 60% marks, or 50% for eligible SC, ST and PwBD candidates, can apply online with a valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 score.

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 online application process will begin on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM and close on 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. The maximum age limit is 30 years, with applicable relaxation for reserved categories. Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Rs.50,000 to Rs.1,60,000 under E2 Grade, with approximate annual emoluments of Rs.16–17 lakh. Selection will be based on GATE scores, Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates can check the vacancy details, educational qualifications, age limit, application fees, salary, selection criteria and online application instructions below.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification Out

NHPC Limited has issued Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/07/2026 dated 24 November 2026 for the recruitment of 205 Trainee Engineers through GATE 2025 and GATE 2026. The vacancies are available in Civil, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering disciplines for NHPC and NHDC Limited. The recruitment is open to eligible Engineering graduates who have qualified in the corresponding GATE examination.

The official NHPC Trainee Engineer notification provides discipline-wise and category-wise vacancies, academic qualifications, age limits, reservation, application fees, pay scale and selection criteria. Candidates must possess a valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 score in the prescribed paper. Scores from other GATE years are not accepted for this recruitment.

Can Freshers Apply for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026?

Yes, fresh Engineering graduates can apply for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 if they have completed the prescribed Engineering qualification with the required marks and possess a valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 score in the relevant paper. Previous work experience is not mandatory. However, candidates who are still appearing in their final-year Engineering examination are not eligible for this recruitment.

Important: This is a quick eligibility guide and does not confirm individual eligibility. Candidates should carefully check their Engineering discipline, aggregate marks, GATE paper code, age and other requirements against the official notification.

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 eligibility conditions are based on educational qualifications, valid GATE examination scores, age and reservation requirements. Candidates must possess a full-time Engineering Degree in the prescribed discipline or an eligible AMIE qualification. Only the notified Engineering disciplines and corresponding GATE paper codes are accepted.

NHPC has prescribed a full-time regular Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology or B.Sc Engineering in the relevant discipline from a recognised Indian university or AICTE-approved institution. An eligible AMIE qualification with enrolment up to 31 May 2013 is also accepted. Candidates must have secured at least 60% marks, relaxed to 50% for eligible SC, ST and PwBD candidates.

Candidates must have qualified in GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 and possess a valid score in the corresponding Engineering paper. EWS Rs.708
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Rs.708
SC Nil

Important: Additional bank or processing charges, including GST where applicable, must be borne by the applicant. The registration fee is non-refundable.

Candidates applying separately for NHPC and NHDC Trainee Engineer vacancies in Electrical or Mechanical disciplines must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each application, unless exempted.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Salary 2026

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Salary 2026 is based on E2 Grade with a pay scale of Rs.50,000–1,60,000 under the IDA pattern. Selected candidates will receive this pay scale during the one-year training period. On successful completion of training, they will be absorbed as Engineers in the same pay scale, with a probation period of one year. The approximate annual emoluments for a new employee are Rs.16–17 lakh.

Salary Component Details
Post Name Trainee Engineer
Pay Grade E2
Pay Scale Rs.50,000–1,60,000 (IDA)
Starting Basic Pay Rs.50,000
Annual Increment 3%
Approximate Annual Emoluments Rs.16–17 Lakh
Training Duration 1 Year
Post-Training Designation Engineer
Probation After Training 1 Year

In addition to basic pay, selected employees will be eligible for Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Cafeteria Allowance, Performance Related Pay, medical facilities and social security benefits such as Provident Fund, pension and gratuity according to the applicable company rules.

Note: The approximate annual emoluments of Rs.16–17 lakh are not the same as the monthly in-hand salary. Actual take-home pay will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process 2026

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process 2026 consists of shortlisting through GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates with a valid score in the corresponding GATE paper will be considered for shortlisting based on the normalised marks out of 100. The final merit will be prepared using the prescribed weightage for GATE, Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

1. GATE Score-Based Shortlisting

NHPC will shortlist candidates based on the best valid normalised marks obtained in GATE 2025 or GATE 2026. Ordinarily, candidates up to five times the number of advertised vacancies in each category and discipline may be called for the next selection stages. If candidates have equal marks at the shortlisting boundary, all such candidates may be called according to the notification.

2. Group Discussion

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Group Discussion. Group Discussion carries 5% weightage in the final selection score. There is no separate qualifying cut-off for Group Discussion, but candidates must satisfy the combined minimum qualifying requirements for Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

3. Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted through GATE will also appear for a Personal Interview carrying 20% weightage. Candidates must submit the prescribed consent form and attend the selection process according to the schedule communicated by NHPC.

4. Psychometric Assessment, If Required

NHPC may conduct an online or offline Psychometric Assessment for candidates shortlisted for Group Discussion and Personal Interview. The assessment results may be used as an input during the interview.

5. Document Verification and Final Selection

Candidates must produce the required educational, category, GATE and other supporting documents during the selection process. Final empanelment will depend on the prescribed composite merit, minimum qualifying standards, document verification and other eligibility conditions.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Weightage 2026

NHPC has prescribed a combined selection weightage of 75% for GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 normalised marks, 5% for Group Discussion and 20% for Personal Interview. The final score will be calculated out of 100 using these components.

Selection Component Weightage
GATE 2025 / GATE 2026 Normalised Marks 75%
Group Discussion 5%
Personal Interview 20%
Total 100%

NHPC Group Discussion and Interview Qualifying Marks 2026

Candidates must obtain the prescribed minimum qualifying percentage in the combined score of Group Discussion and Personal Interview. There is no separate minimum qualifying mark for Group Discussion alone.

Category Minimum Combined GD and Interview Score
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS 40%
SC / ST / PwBD 30%

Candidates who do not qualify in the combined Group Discussion and Personal Interview score will not be considered for final empanelment, regardless of their GATE marks.

NHPC Trainee Engineer GATE Exam Pattern 2026

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 does not prescribe a separate NHPC written examination. Selection is based on valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates must have qualified in the corresponding GATE paper before applying.

NHPC Post Accepted GATE Paper Paper Code
Trainee Engineer (Civil) Civil Engineering CE
Trainee Engineer (Electrical) Electrical Engineering EE
Trainee Engineer (Mechanical) Mechanical Engineering ME

Only valid GATE 2025 and GATE 2026 normalised marks out of 100 are accepted for this recruitment. Candidates should not confuse these marks with the GATE score reported on the 1,000-point scale.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Service Bond 2026

Candidates selected under NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 must execute a service agreement and surety bond to serve the organisation for a minimum of four years, including the training period. The bond amount varies according to the candidate's category.

Candidate Category Service Bond Amount
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS Rs.4,00,000 Plus Applicable GST
SC / ST / PwBD Rs.2,00,000 Plus Applicable GST

Service Commitment: Minimum four years, including the training period.

Candidates should carefully read the service bond conditions before accepting an appointment.

Documents Required for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026

Candidates applying for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 must upload scanned copies of the prescribed documents through the online application portal. The documents must be clear and readable, and the information must match the details entered in the application form.

  • Matriculation or Secondary School Certificate as Proof of Date of Birth
  • Class 12 Marksheet or Certificate
  • Complete Engineering Degree Mark Sheets and Qualification Certificate
  • Valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 Scorecard
  • Certificate Confirming Full-Time Regular Engineering Qualification, Where Required
  • CGPA / Grade-to-Percentage Conversion Certificate, If Applicable
  • SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS Certificate, If Applicable
  • PwBD Disability Certificate, If Applicable
  • Recent Passport-Size Colour Photograph
  • Scanned Signature
  • No Objection Certificate for Government / PSU Employees, If Applicable
  • Other Declarations or Supporting Certificates Required Under the Notification

The official notification prescribes PDF files of 100 KB to 400 KB for supporting certificates. The passport-size photograph must be uploaded in JPEG format with a file size below 50 KB, while the signature must be below 25 KB.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Apply Online 2026

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Apply Online 2026 process will begin on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM for 205 Civil, Electrical and Mechanical vacancies. Eligible candidates with valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores can submit their applications through the official NHPC Careers website until 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Candidates must enter the correct GATE registration number, select the appropriate post and upload all supporting documents.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026: Official Apply Online Website

Important: Candidates applying for Electrical or Mechanical vacancies in both NHPC and NHDC must submit separate applications. The prescribed application fee, where applicable, will be charged separately for each application.

How to Apply for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can submit their NHPC Trainee Engineer application forms through the official NHPC Careers website. Follow the steps below.

  1. Visit the official NHPC website at nhpcindia.com.
  2. Open the Careers section.
  3. Find Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/07/2026 for Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026.
  4. Download and read the complete recruitment notification.
  5. Check the educational qualification, GATE paper code, minimum marks, age limit and category requirements.
  6. Open the online registration link when activated on 27 November 2026.
  7. Enter personal details, contact information and the valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 registration number.
  8. Select the appropriate Engineering discipline and NHPC or NHDC vacancy, as applicable.
  9. Enter the required academic qualifications and GATE normalised marks out of 100.
  10. Upload the prescribed educational certificates, GATE scorecard, category certificates and other documents.
  11. Upload the passport-size photograph and signature according to the specified file requirements.
  12. Review the complete application form carefully.
  13. Pay the applicable registration fee if required.
  14. Submit the online application before 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
  15. Save the system-generated unique registration number and print the registration form for future reference.

Important: Candidates are not required to send the printed registration form or supporting documents by post. Applications will be accepted only through the prescribed online process.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Training and Job Location 2026

Selected Trainee Engineers will undergo one year of training in E2 Grade with a pay scale of Rs.50,000–1,60,000. After successful completion of training, they will be absorbed as Engineers in the same pay scale and placed on probation for one year.

Selected candidates may be posted at NHPC or NHDC projects, power stations, offices, joint ventures or subsidiary companies in different parts of India or abroad, according to organisational requirements.

Important Instructions for NHPC Trainee Engineer Applicants

Candidates applying for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 should carefully follow the official instructions regarding eligibility, GATE scores, documents, application fees and the selection procedure.

  • A total of 205 Trainee Engineer vacancies have been announced.
  • The recruitment includes 188 NHPC and 17 NHDC vacancies.
  • Only candidates with valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores are eligible.
  • Civil applicants must have GATE paper code CE, Electrical applicants EE and Mechanical applicants ME.
  • Candidates who appeared in both GATE 2025 and 2026 must submit their best valid score.
  • GATE scores from earlier years or other years are not accepted.
  • Final-year Engineering students are not eligible to apply.
  • The maximum age is 30 years as on 26 December 2026, before applicable relaxation.
  • Online applications open on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM.
  • The last date to submit the application is 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
  • Separate applications are required for NHPC and NHDC Electrical or Mechanical vacancies.
  • Applicants must pay the applicable registration fee separately for each application unless exempted.
  • Shortlisting will be based on GATE normalised marks, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview.
  • Selected candidates must execute the prescribed four-year service bond.
  • Candidates must meet the applicable medical fitness standards.
  • Applicants should regularly check the official NHPC website for recruitment updates.

The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Northern Railway has released the RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification for 4,651 Act Apprentice training slots under Advertisement No. RRC/NR/03/2026/Act Apprentice. Candidates who have passed Class 10 with at least 50% marks and possess an ITI certificate in the relevant trade can apply for apprenticeship training across Northern Railway divisions and workshops.

The RRC NR Apprentice 2026 online application process started on 11 November 2026, and eligible candidates can apply through the official website www.rrcnr.org until 11 December 2026 (11:59 PM). Selection will be based on Class 10 and ITI marks without a written examination or interview. Candidates should check the vacancy details, eligibility, age limit and application fee before submitting their forms.

Organisation Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Northern Railway

Eligible candidates can submit the RRC NR Apprentice online application form from 11 November to 11 December 2026. The merit list is expected to be displayed in February 2027.

Candidates must check the trade-wise and unit-wise training slots in Annexure-A of the official notification before selecting a cluster. Applications submitted for units where the candidate's ITI trade is not notified may be rejected.

RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for Northern Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification and age requirements specified in the notification.

Educational Qualification

  • Must have passed Class 10 (Matriculation) or equivalent under the 10+2 examination system from a recognised board.
  • Must have secured at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 10.
  • Must possess an ITI qualification in the relevant trade recognised by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Both Class 10 and ITI qualifications must have been completed on or before 06 November 2026.

Note: Candidates awaiting their Class 10 or ITI results as of the notification date are not eligible to apply.

RRC NR Apprentice Age Limit 2026

The age limit for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 11 December 2026.

Minimum Age 15 Years

  • SC/ST: 5 Years
  • OBC: 3 Years
  • PwBD: 10 Years
  • Ex-Servicemen: As per the conditions mentioned in the official notification

RRC NR Apprentice Application Fee 2026

Category Application Fee

SC / ST No Fee

Women Candidates No Fee

The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable online transaction charges, if any, must be paid by the candidate.

RRC NR Apprentice Selection Process 2026

Selection for RRC NR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on merit calculated from Class 10 and ITI marks. There will be no written examination or interview.

  • Screening and scrutiny of online applications.
  • Preparation of merit lists based on the average percentage of Class 10 and ITI marks, with equal weightage.
  • Document verification of shortlisted candidates.
  • Fulfilment of prescribed medical fitness requirements.

Merit Calculation: (Class 10 Percentage + ITI Percentage) / 2

If two candidates receive the same merit score, preference will be given to the older candidate. If their dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.

RRC NR Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected apprentices will receive a stipend during their training according to the applicable Apprenticeship Rules. The official RRC NR notification does not specify a fixed monthly stipend amount for each trade.

Apprenticeship training does not guarantee permanent employment in Northern Railway after completion of the training period.

How to Apply Online for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through the official website before 11 December 2026.

  1. Visit the official Northern Railway RRC website at www.rrcnr.org.
  2. Find the Engagement of Act Apprentice 2026 online application link.
  3. Complete registration using your personal details, mobile number and email ID.
  4. Log in using the registration credentials.
  5. Enter the required personal, educational and ITI qualification details.
  6. Select the appropriate cluster and unit based on the available slots for your ITI trade.
  7. Upload the required photograph, signature, thumb impression and certificates.
  8. Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
  9. Review the details and submit the application form.
  10. Download and print the submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

Important: Only one application is permitted per candidate. Multiple applications may lead to rejection, and changes are not allowed after final submission.

The Export-Import Bank of India (India Exim Bank) has announced a recruitment drive for Management Trainee and Manager posts in 2026. The bank invites applications from eligible candidates for a total of 120 positions, including 90 Management Trainee and 30 Manager vacancies.

The short recruitment notice was published on 11 November 2026, and the last date for submitting applications is 11 December 2026. Interested candidates can visit the official Exim Bank careers website for the detailed advertisement, eligibility conditions and online application information.

Exim Bank Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

India Exim Bank has announced 120 vacancies for Management Trainee and Manager positions. The recruitment includes 90 Management Trainee vacancies and 30 Manager vacancies. The post-wise details are provided below:

Post Name No. of Posts
Management Trainee (MT) 90
Manager 30
Total 120

By category, the 90 Management Trainee posts are UR 40, SC 07, ST 09, OBC (NCL) 25 and EWS 9 (including 03 PwBD). The 30 Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) posts are UR 15, SC 03, ST 02, OBC (NCL) 07 and EWS 03 (including 01 PwBD).

Who Can Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?

Candidates with relevant educational qualifications in management, finance, commerce and other professional disciplines may be eligible for Exim Bank Management Trainee and Manager positions. Final qualification and experience requirements should be checked against the detailed recruitment advertisement.

  • Management Trainee: Minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent Cumulative Grade Points Average (CGPA), in Graduation. The graduation course should be of a minimum 3-year full-time duration. and Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade or Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA). Post Graduation course should be of a minimum 2-year full-time duration, with a specialization in Finance with minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. In case of CA or CMA, passing the professional examination is sufficient. Membership of ICAI in case of CA is mandatory.
  • Manager: Candidates with relevant graduation, postgraduate or professional qualifications and the required post-qualification work experience may be eligible. The detailed advertisement will specify the accepted qualifications and experience. The detailed notification says Manager posts need at least 60% marks in Graduation and a relevant Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) or CA, which varies by stream, plus at least 4 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field.

Note: Candidates should verify the prescribed qualification, minimum marks, experience and other eligibility conditions before submitting an application. Candidates appearing in their final qualifying examinations by May 2027 may also take the written examination. Post-graduation done through online / correspondence / part-time / distance mode is not accepted.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

  • Management Trainee: The previous recruitment eligibility range was 21 to 28 years. The age limit for the 2026 recruitment is subject to confirmation in the detailed notification. The detailed notification confirms it as not below 21 and not above 28 years as on 01 November 2026.
  • Manager: The minimum and maximum age limits will be specified in the detailed notification. The detailed notification sets it at not below 24 and not above 30 years as on 01 November 2026.
  • Age Relaxation: Applicable category-wise relaxation will be governed by the official recruitment rules. The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (NCL). For PwBD it is relaxed by 10 years (General/EWS), 13 years (OBC-NCL) and 15 years (SC/ST), and Ex-servicemen get up to 5 years.

The age calculation cutoff date and applicable relaxations should be verified from the detailed Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 notification.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

  • General / OBC Candidates: Rs. 600/- (Application fee and intimation charges)
  • SC / ST / PwBD / EWS / Female Candidates: Rs. 100/- (Intimation charges only)
  • Payment Mode: As specified in the official application instructions. Payment is online only (Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards / Mobile Wallets) from 27-11-2026 to 11-12-2026.

The category-wise application fee for this recruitment has not been confirmed in the short notice. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification before making any payment. The detailed notification now confirms the fee shown above, and fees once paid are non-refundable.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Salary

  • Management Trainee: Rs. 65,000/- monthly stipend during the one-year training. After training they are absorbed as Deputy Manager (JM-I) in the pay scale Rs. 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920 (CTC about Rs. 25 lakh a year).
  • Manager (MM-II): Rs. 64820-2340-67160-2680-93960 (CTC about Rs. 30 lakh a year).

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process and Exam Pattern

Selection will be through a Written Test and a Personal Interview. The written test is a subjective Professional Knowledge paper of 100 marks lasting 2 hours 30 minutes. Part I is a compulsory question or case study (40 marks) and in Part II candidates attempt any 6 of 8 questions (60 marks), all based on the selected specialization. The final selection is based on 70% weightage for the written test and 30% for the interview. The exam will be held in Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai and New Delhi, and interviews in Mumbai and / or New Delhi.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the official India Exim Bank website at https://www.eximbankindia.in/.
  • Open the Careers section on the homepage.
  • Find the recruitment advertisement for Management Trainee and Manager posts.
  • Download and read the detailed notification carefully.
  • Check the required educational qualifications, age limit and experience conditions.
  • Open the official online application link when available (the link will be live from 27 November 2026).
  • Complete the registration process using the required personal and contact details.
  • Fill in the application form with accurate educational, personal and professional information.
  • Upload the required documents, photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as instructed.
  • Pay the application fee, if applicable.
  • Submit the completed application form by 11 December 2026 and save a copy for future reference.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

BHEL-PPPU, Thirumayam of Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (A Government of India Undertaking) is engaging 40 Trade Apprentices in seven ITI trades under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for the year 2026-27, for one year of training on a consolidated stipend of Rs.11,040/- or Rs.10,560/- per month, depending on the trade. Candidates need High School pass and ITI pass as a regular full-time candidate from an NCVT recognized institute, plus an RDSDE (NAPS) registration number. Applications are accepted only online through the BHEL Trichy portal (trichy.bhel.com, Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM)) from 26 November 2026 to 10 December 2026.

BHEL Thirumayam Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

ParticularsDetails
OrganisationBharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), BHEL-PPPU, Thirumayam
Advertisement No.No.PPPU:HR:ACTAPP:2026-27
TenureOne year from the date of joining, as per Apprentices Act, 1961
Post Name(s)Trade Apprentice – Fitter, Welder, Machinist, Instrument Mechanic, Electrician, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Plumber / Pump Operator-Cum-Mechanic
Vacancies40 (tentative)
PayStipend of Rs.11,040/- or Rs.10,560/- per month (Consolidated), by trade
Age LimitMinimum 18 years and Maximum 27 years as on 01.11.2026 for General candidates
Job LocationBHEL Thirumayam
Application ModeOnline only
Last Date to Apply10.12.2026

The official notification does not specify the application fee.

About BHEL Thirumayam

Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited is a Government of India Undertaking, and this circular is issued by its BHEL-PPPU unit at Thirumayam. The engagement of Trade Apprentices is made under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for the training year 2026-2027, and the circular is signed by N V Raja Vikram, Senior Manager (HR). BHEL has also requested the District Employment Office to share the information with suitable candidates.

Vacancy Details

BHEL Thirumayam has notified 40 Trade Apprentice vacancies across seven trades. The notice calls the number in each trade tentative: it may increase or decrease in all or any of the trades depending upon requirement, at the absolute discretion of the management.

Sl. No.TradeStipend Per Month (Consolidated)Tentative No. of Vacancies
1FitterRs.11,040/-10
2Welder - G&E / TIG & MIG / Pipe & Pressure Vessel/ Structural / AdvanceRs.10,560/-12
3MachinistRs.11,040/-6
4Instrument MechanicRs.11,040/-2
5ElectricianRs.11,040/-5
6Mechanic (Motor Vehicle)Rs.11,040/-2
7Plumber / Pump Operator-Cum-MechanicRs. 10,560/-3
Total40

Reservation

Out of the training vacancies, 19%, 1%, 27%, 10% and 4% are reserved for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) candidates respectively. The notice gives these percentages only, not trade-wise category numbers. Reservation for dependents of regular employees (Serving/Retired/Deceased) will be governed as per company rules.

Who Can Apply

Educational Qualification

The same minimum educational qualification applies to all seven trades: High School Pass and ITI pass as a Regular Full Time candidate from NCVT recognized institute. For all trades in Table No. 1, an NCVT certificate is required. Candidates who have completed their full-time ITI course are eligible to apply.

Age Limit

The age limit is minimum 18 years and maximum 27 years as on 01.11.2026 for General candidates. The relaxations below apply to the upper age limit.

CategoryRelaxation in Upper Age Limit
SC/ST5 years
OBC (NCL)3 years
PwD (with minimum 40% disability)10 years

Who Is Not Eligible

  • Candidates who completed their ITI through Distance Learning/Part Time/Correspondence/Sandwich courses shall not be considered for apprenticeship training in BHEL.
  • Candidates who have already undergone, or are currently undergoing, apprenticeship training in any other establishment under the Apprentices Act, 1961 are not eligible to apply.

Other Conditions

  • Candidates must be registered on the RDSDE (NAPS) portal (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in); only candidates with an RDSDE (NAPS) Registration No. will be considered.
  • Only candidates who passed their qualifying examination from recognized academic institutions located in the state of Tamilnadu will be considered for selection. If Tamilnadu candidates are not available for any branch, vacancies will be filled with other candidates as per procedure for such trades.
  • Candidates selected as apprentices will have to fulfil the minimum physical fitness standard / parameters specified in the Apprentices Act, Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 and amendments thereof, if any.
  • Candidates must have an active e-mail ID and mobile phone number that remain valid for at least the next one year.

Candidates should check the official notification for the trade-specific eligibility of each post.

Pay and Tenure

The stipend is a consolidated monthly amount: Rs.11,040/- for Fitter, Machinist, Instrument Mechanic, Electrician and Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), and Rs.10,560/- for Welder and Plumber / Pump Operator-Cum-Mechanic. The duration of apprenticeship training is one year from the date of joining, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.

Upon completion of the apprenticeship period at BHEL Thirumayam, BHEL shall have no obligation to offer employment to the apprentices, and an apprentice cannot claim a right to employment on the ground of completing the apprenticeship.

How to Apply for BHEL Thirumayam Recruitment 2026

Only online applications are accepted. The application has two parts: registration on the Government apprenticeship portal, then the application on the BHEL portal.

Step A: Registration on the Apprenticeship (NAPS) Portal

  1. Go to www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, click "Register" and choose "candidate".
  2. Fill in all personal details and click submit; note the 10-digit unique registration number shown on screen, which must be entered in the BHEL online apprentice portal.
  3. Open the e-mail with the subject "User activation" in your registered mailbox and click the activate button.
  4. Log in to www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in with the registered mail ID/registration number and password, and complete your profile under the "profile" tab using the EDIT and ADD buttons.
  5. Complete Aadhaar verification, which is mandatory for creating the online apprenticeship contract; your name, date of birth, gender and father's name in Aadhaar must match your 10th standard (SSLC) mark sheet. If there is a discrepancy, get the Aadhaar corrected from the concerned agency.
  6. Complete e-KYC verification by filling in bank details and IFSC code correctly.

Step B: Application on the BHEL Portal

  1. Go to https://trichy.bhel.com and click the link "Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM)".
  2. Click "Register" from the menu, read the instructions and accept by clicking "I agree".
  3. Fill in the registration form and click "REGISTER"; an OTP will be sent to your registered e-mail ID and mobile number.
  4. Create a new password using the OTP and log in to the portal with it.
  5. Fill in the application form, including your RDSDE (NAPS) registration number.
  6. Upload the scanned documents listed below, in the size indicated in the portal.
  7. Submit the application by 10 December 2026 and save a copy to produce at document verification.

Documents to Upload

  • Latest passport size colour photograph
  • Candidate's signature
  • 10th Standard mark sheet
  • Consolidated mark sheet of prescribed educational qualification
  • Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC (NCL), EWS, PwD certificate); the OBC (NCL) and EWS certificate must be as per the latest government guidelines and not older than one year
  • Aadhaar Card
  • Screenshot of the candidate's profile home page on the Govt. portal (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in)
  • Bank passbook front page as uploaded in the Govt. portal, Aadhaar seeded and DBT enabled

If any single document is missing, the application shall be summarily rejected. Blurred or edited images and incorrect documents will also be summarily rejected.

Selection Process

Selection is based on fulfilling the conditions of the notification. A merit list will be drawn based on the marks secured in the qualifying examination. In case of a tie in marks, the candidate older in age will be preferred. Information about the eligible list of candidates for document verification and apprentice training will be published at https://trichy.bhel.com (Our services, then Apprenticeship Application Portal (THIRUMAYAM)) or sent through e-mail/SMS alerts. The copy of the online application must be produced at document verification.

Important Dates

EventDate
Date of circular25.11.2026
Online Application Opening Date26.11.2026
Online Application Closing Date10.12.2026

Important Instructions

  • Incomplete applications, applications not meeting the eligibility criteria and applications sent in any mode other than online will be treated as "Rejected".
  • The candidate must verify all information before final submission and is wholly responsible for the details given in the online form.
  • All future communication will take place only through the website, e-mail and SMS alerts, so candidates should check https://trichy.bhel.com and their registered e-mail regularly.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for certificate verification or for joining the apprenticeship training.
  • Canvassing in any form is liable to render the candidate ineligible.

EdCIL (India) Limited, a Mini Ratna Category-1 CPSE under the Ministry of Education, on behalf of the Ministry of Education and Skills Development of the Royal Government of Bhutan (RGoB), invites online applications from Indian PGT teachers for 40 contract posts in higher secondary schools of Bhutan: 30 in Computer Science/ICT and 10 in Mathematics. The consolidated gross remuneration is Rs. 1,40,000 per month for a minimum tenure of two years. The essential qualification is a Master's Degree in the relevant field with at least 60% marks and 5 years of teaching experience. Applications are accepted only at https://edcilteacherrecruitment.com from 25 November 2026 to 11 December 2026.

EdCIL Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

ParticularsDetails
OrganisationEdCIL (India) Limited, on behalf of the Royal Government of Bhutan
Advertisement No.EdCIL/Bhutan Secondment of STEM Teachers/ 2026-27
Post Name(s)PGT Teacher – Computer Science/ICT; PGT Teacher – Mathematics
Vacancies40 (Computer Science/ICT 30, Mathematics 10)
TenureMinimum two years, contract basis
PayRs. 1,40,000/- per month, consolidated gross remuneration
Age LimitMaximum 55 years as on 25 November 2026
Job LocationAnywhere in Bhutan
Application ModeOnline
Last Date to Apply11 December 2026

The official notification does not specify the application fee.

About EdCIL

EdCIL (India) Limited is a Mini Ratna Category-1 CPSE under the Ministry of Education, located at EdCIL House, 18-A, Sector 16-A, NOIDA 201301 (UP). This notice is titled "Recruitment of STEM Teachers for the Royal Government of Bhutan – Phase IV". The teachers are engaged for the Bhutan Government's higher secondary schools, and the decision on shortlisting and final selection rests with the Royal Government of Bhutan.

Vacancy Details

The notice lists 40 vacancies in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

Sl. NoPostVacancies
1Computer Science/ICT30
2Mathematics10
Total40

Who Can Apply

Only Indian Nationals can apply. Both posts are for PGT teachers, and the qualification is the same for both except for the B.Ed. rule.

PostEssential QualificationDesirable
Computer Science/ICTMaster's Degree in the relevant field from a recognized university with at least 60% marksB.Ed. from a recognized university is preferable (not mandatory)
MathematicsMaster's Degree in the relevant field from a recognized university with at least 60% marks; B.Ed. from a recognized university is mandatoryNot specified in the notice

Computer Science/ICT

  • Proficiency in teaching in the English Language.
  • 5 years' work experience in teaching relevant subjects for grade 7 to 12. Teaching experience in universities or institutions beyond grade 12 is also considered, provided the candidate has prior teaching experience in schools.
  • High proficiency in use of technology for education in Computer Science/ICT. Experience in providing instructional leadership in technology is listed (evidence of using emerging ed-tech, advanced ICT tools for teaching, ICT trainings or professional development programmes conducted).

Mathematics

  • Proficiency in teaching in the English Language.
  • 5 years' work experience in teaching relevant subjects for grade 7 to 12. Teaching experience in universities or institutions beyond grade 12 is also considered, provided the candidate has prior teaching experience in schools.
  • High proficiency in use of technology for education in Mathematics (evidence of initiatives in using ICT in teaching mathematics).

Conditions for both posts

  • Age: maximum 55 years as on 25 November 2026. The cut-off date for educational qualification, age limit, experience and other eligibility criteria is 25 November 2026.
  • No age or category relaxation is given.
  • Good physical fitness and no medical condition that may hinder service during the contract term; a medical certificate is to be submitted at the time of joining.
  • Candidates must be prepared to teach classes 7 to 12.
  • Candidates working in Government organizations must submit an NOC/Vigilance/Service certificate at document verification or interview, if shortlisted.

Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

Pay and Tenure

  • Teachers are paid a consolidated gross remuneration of Rs. 1,40,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Forty Thousand only) per month from the date of joining.
  • Local tax as per the "Income Tax Act and Health" contribution of 1% applies on the gross remuneration.
  • The tenure is a minimum of two years. It may be renewed based on performance and subject requirements.
  • Teachers may be posted and relocated anywhere in Bhutan depending on the requirement of the RGoB.
  • The RGoB provides all necessary assistance for the work permit as applicable.
  • Leave, medical benefits, travel passage and other terms of employment are as per the contract with the RGoB.
  • Selected candidates get air tickets for to-and-fro travel on the India–Bhutan sector at the start and end of the tenure only. Travel of dependents, spouses or family members is arranged by the candidate.
  • If a candidate returns to India before completing the tenure, the cost of travel is borne by the candidate. Travel for vacation or personal visits to India during the tenure is also at the candidate's cost.

How to Apply for EdCIL Recruitment 2026

  1. Apply online through the EdCIL website https://edcilteacherrecruitment.com. No other mode of application is accepted.
  2. Keep a valid personal email ID active throughout the recruitment. All details are shared through the registered email ID, and the ID should not be shared with any other person.
  3. Write the name, date of birth and parents' names exactly as in the Class X certificates or mark sheets. Any change or alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  4. Fill in the online application form, and scan and upload the recent photograph and signature as the form instructs.
  5. The login ID and password are sent by email on registration. Keep that mail until all steps are complete.
  6. Submit the application by 11 December 2026. No modification is allowed after submission.

The notice advises candidates not to wait for the last date and time, and to register well before it. For problems with the online form, contact the EdCIL Help Desk on 0120-6565065 (10 AM to 5 PM, Monday to Friday only) or at [email protected]. Queries can also be checked in the FAQs section on the website.

Documents named in the notice (keep ready before applying)

  • Email ID.
  • Marksheets of Class X and XII, and final marksheets of Graduation, Post-graduation and B.Ed., as applicable.
  • Latest updated resume covering qualifications, skills and proficiencies (English and ICT tools); the committee uses it for shortlisting.
  • Any other qualification documents to be filled in the application.
  • Scanned recent photograph (not more than 1 month old, jpg/jpeg) and scanned signature in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg); each image minimum 20 kb and maximum 50 kb.
  • Work experience certificate with last pay drawn. If it is not available, a joining letter with the latest 3-month salary slip may be submitted. It must be on the employer's letterhead; handwritten certificates are not accepted as proof.
  • PAN Card and Passport / Voter-ID as ID proof. A passport must be valid till the end of the tenure.

Selection and Interview

A panel of officials from India and the Royal Government of Bhutan shortlists eligible candidates for interview. Meeting the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to an interview. EdCIL/RGoB reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates after preliminary screening and short-listing by qualifications, suitability and experience.

  • Shortlisted candidates are informed of the venue, date and schedule on their registered email IDs only. The physical interview is held in New Delhi only.
  • Document verification takes place at the interview. Candidates bring the application printout with photograph affixed and original self-attested copies of certificates for age, qualification, work experience and others as applicable.
  • Any change of name needs valid government-issued proof at document verification on the day of the interview.
  • Selected candidates undergo mandatory medical screening including a drug test on arrival in Bhutan. Those who pass both sign the employment contract; those who fail return to India.
  • The RGoB decides the recruitment process, including shortlisting and final selection.

Important Dates

EventDate
Commencement of online registration25 November 2026
Last date for online registration11 December 2026

Important Instructions

  • EdCIL does not enter into correspondence about candidature, and no separate intimation is sent. Call letters and all announcements go to the registered email only.
  • Downloading or printing the admit card or interview letter is the candidate's responsibility. Candidates should check the spam folder from time to time. EdCIL is not responsible for emails lost due to a wrong email ID.
  • Admission at all stages is provisional. EdCIL may verify eligibility at any time before or after selection, and issue of a call letter does not mean candidature is finally cleared.
  • If the online data differs from the original testimonials, the candidature is liable to be rejected. Incomplete applications are rejected.
  • Original documents must be produced at the interview. A missing document may lead to cancellation of the candidature.
  • A request for change of interview date or venue will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • A candidate can be disqualified and debarred, permanently or for a specified period, for impersonation, irregular means, obtaining support for candidature, or false, tampered or fabricated particulars.
  • Terms of appointment, employment, termination and renewal follow the applicable laws of the Royal Government of Bhutan. Disputes are subject to the courts having jurisdiction in Delhi only.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must have completed graduation from a Government-recognized university or institution and possess the specified experience as commissioned officers in the Armed Forces or officers in paramilitary forces.
