Candidates applying for Manager (Security) in MMGS-III must satisfy either of the following conditions:

  • An officer not below the rank of Major in the Indian Army or equivalent rank in the Indian Navy or Air Force, with at least 10 years of commissioned service.
  • An officer not below the rank of Deputy Commandant in paramilitary forces, with at least 10 years of service as an officer in the force.

SBI Deputy Manager (Security) Experience Requirements

Candidates applying for Deputy Manager (Security) in MMGS-II must satisfy either of the following conditions:

  • An officer not below the rank of Captain in the Indian Army or equivalent rank in the Indian Navy or Air Force, with at least 5 years of commissioned service.
  • An officer not below the rank of Assistant Commandant in paramilitary forces, with at least 5 years of service as an officer in the force.

Paramilitary Officer Experience Minimum 10 Years Minimum 5 Years

SBI SO Medical Fitness Requirement

Only candidates possessing medical fitness in SHAPE-1 or an equivalent medical category as on the release date of the advertisement are eligible.

Retired candidates must upload the relevant medical category information from their discharge book or service record. Candidates currently serving must upload their latest Medical Board document indicating their medical category.

Important: SBI requires supporting documents for service experience and medical fitness during online application. Applications without the prescribed documents may not be considered for shortlisting or interview.

SBI SO Age Limit 2026

The age limit for Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) is 25 to 40 years as on 31 October 2026, with applicable upper-age relaxation for eligible reserved categories.

Age Criteria Details
Minimum Age 25 Years
Maximum Age 40 Years
Age Calculation Date 31 October 2026
Age Relaxation As per Government of India Guidelines, Where Applicable

SBI states that cumulative age relaxation will not be available. Applicants claiming relaxation must produce the relevant certificates when required.

SBI SO Salary 2026

The starting basic pay is Rs. 85,920 for Manager (Security) and Rs. 64,820 for Deputy Manager (Security). Both positions are regular Specialist Cadre Officer posts.

Post Name Grade Basic Pay Scale
Manager (Security) MMGS-III Rs. 85,920 - Rs. 1,05,820
Deputy Manager (Security) MMGS-II Rs. 64,820 - Rs. 93,960

Detailed SBI SO Pay Scale

Post Pay Progression
Manager (Security) Rs. 85,920-2680/5-99,320-2980/2-1,05,820
Deputy Manager (Security) Rs. 64,820-2340/1-67,160-2680/10-93,960

Selected officers will also be eligible for applicable Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), Provident Fund, National Pension System (NPS), Leave Fare Concession, medical facilities and other benefits under SBI rules.

Salary Clarification: These amounts represent basic pay scales, not guaranteed monthly in-hand salaries. Actual earnings depend on allowances, posting and applicable deductions.

SBI SO Probation Period

The probation period for Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) is six months, as specified in the recruitment notification.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The application fee is Rs. 750 for General, EWS and OBC candidates. SC and ST candidates are exempt from the fee.

Category Application Fee
General / UR Rs. 750
EWS Rs. 750
OBC Rs. 750
SC Nil
ST Nil

Payment Mode: Online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking or UPI.

The application fee is non-refundable. Registration is completed only after successful payment of the applicable fee.

SBI SO Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of an online written examination followed by a personal interview. The final merit calculation gives 70% weightage to Professional Knowledge and 30% to the interview.

  1. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the objective examination.
  2. Shortlisting: SBI shortlists candidates based on the examination results and applicable requirements.
  3. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates attend an interview carrying 100 marks.
  4. Document Verification: Educational qualifications, service experience, medical fitness and category certificates are verified.
  5. Final Merit List: Prepared using normalized Professional Knowledge and interview marks.

SBI reserves the right to modify the selection process, including considering shortlisting followed by interview, if required.

SBI SO Exam Pattern 2026

The online written examination contains 200 objective questions carrying 200 marks, with a total duration of two hours.

Subject Questions Marks Duration
Reasoning Ability 50 25 30 Minutes
English Language 50 50 30 Minutes
General Awareness 50 25 25 Minutes
Professional Knowledge 50 100 35 Minutes
Total 200 200 120 Minutes

Important SBI SO Exam Rules

  • Reasoning Ability, English Language and General Awareness are qualifying in nature.
  • Marks obtained in these three qualifying sections are not counted toward final merit.
  • Candidates must obtain the minimum qualifying marks fixed by SBI in the applicable sections.
  • Professional Knowledge carries 100 marks and contributes to final merit.
  • There is no negative marking for incorrect answers.

SBI SO Final Merit Calculation

Selection Component Maximum Marks Normalized Weightage
Professional Knowledge Test 100 70 Marks
Personal Interview 100 30 Marks
Total 200 100 Marks

If candidates have the same score at the cut-off point, SBI will rank them according to age in descending order.

SBI Security Officer Syllabus 2026

Annexure I of the official notification contains the Professional Knowledge syllabus for Manager and Deputy Manager (Security).

Topic Major Areas
Security Fundamentals Security Concepts, Asset Protection, Threats, Risks and Vulnerabilities
Security Management Security Audit, Surveillance, Access Control, Security Planning and Supervision
Risk Assessment Threat Analysis, Risk Matrix, Vulnerability Assessment and Risk Treatment
Security Equipment Metal Detectors, Scanners, Alarms, Communication Systems and Security Gadgets
Fire Safety Fire Prevention, Extinguishers, Fire Detection and Emergency Response
CCTV Camera Systems, Monitoring, Video Storage and Video Analytics
Manpower Management Deployment, Discipline, Supervision and Security Personnel Management
Executive Protection Basic Principles, Precautions and Security Arrangements
Disaster Management Disaster Response, Emergency Plans and Business Continuity
Information and IT Security Access Control, Information Protection and Physical Security
Security Management in Banks Bank Branch Security, Cash Movement, Vaults, Lockers and ATM Security
Administration Office Management, Leadership, Ethics and Supervision

Candidates should refer to Annexure I of the official notification for the complete topic-wise syllabus rather than relying only on this summary.

SBI Security Officer Job Responsibilities

Selected Manager and Deputy Manager (Security) officers will be responsible for improving security arrangements at SBI branches and offices.

  • Conduct periodic security audits of branches and offices.
  • Review existing security arrangements and recommend improvements.
  • Organize security drills, lectures and employee awareness programmes.
  • Monitor security systems and reduce incidents caused by security lapses.
  • Support implementation of disaster management plans.
  • Visit branches and other administrative units to assess security requirements.
  • Coordinate with civil, military, police and other Government authorities.
  • Perform additional security administration duties assigned by SBI.

Selected officers may be posted or transferred to SBI offices anywhere in India according to the Bank's requirements.

SBI SO Apply Online 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for the 60 Manager and Deputy Manager (Security) vacancies through the official SBI Careers portal from 4 November to 02 December 2026.

Apply Online: SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Recruitment 2026

Advertisement Number: CRPD/SCO/2026-27/28.

Last Date: 02 December 2026.

Applicants should locate the advertisement for Manager (Security) / Deputy Manager (Security) on the SBI Careers page and select its dedicated Apply Online link.

How to Apply Online for SBI SO Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the SBI recruitment official website at sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.
  2. Find Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/28 for Manager (Security) / Deputy Manager (Security).
  3. Download the official notification and verify the educational, service experience and medical fitness requirements.
  4. Click the Apply Online link corresponding to this advertisement.
  5. Complete the new registration process using the required details.
  6. Enter personal information, educational qualifications, service experience and other requested particulars.
  7. Provide the applicable rank, service duration and medical category details.
  8. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  9. Upload the required educational, experience, identity, medical and other supporting certificates.
  10. Review the completed application carefully before submission.
  11. Pay the applicable application fee through the online payment gateway.
  12. Complete the application by 02 December 2026.
  13. Download and save the submitted application form and payment receipt.

Important: Applicants can save an incomplete application and return using the provisional registration number and password. Once the application has been finalized and fee payment completed, further editing is not permitted under the notified instructions.

Documents Required for SBI SO Recruitment 2026

Applicants must upload documents supporting their eligibility, service experience and medical fitness.

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph.
  • Candidate signature.
  • Left-hand thumb impression, or right-hand impression where applicable.
  • Handwritten declaration in the prescribed format.
  • Brief resume.
  • Valid identity proof.
  • Date-of-birth proof.
  • Graduation marksheets and degree certificate.
  • Relevant service experience certificates.
  • Service record or discharge book, as applicable.
  • SHAPE-1 or equivalent medical category supporting document.
  • Latest Medical Board document for currently serving applicants.
  • Applicable caste, OBC-NCL or EWS certificate.
  • No Objection Certificate, where applicable.
  • Other employment and supporting documents required by the official application form.

SBI SO Photograph and Signature Specifications

Document Preferred Dimensions File Size
Photograph 200 x 230 Pixels 20 KB - 50 KB
Signature 140 x 60 Pixels 10 KB - 20 KB
Handwritten Declaration 800 x 400 Pixels 50 KB - 100 KB
Supporting PDF Documents A4 Page Size Up to 500 KB Per File

The handwritten declaration must be written clearly in English using black ink on white paper. Declarations written entirely in capital letters are not accepted. Candidates must also capture a live photograph using a webcam or mobile phone during the online application process.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • The recruitment covers 60 regular Specialist Cadre Officer posts.
  • The posts are Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security).
  • Applications are open from 4 to 02 December 2026.
  • A graduation degree and prescribed officer-level service experience are mandatory.
  • Manager (Security) requires the specified rank and at least 10 years of qualifying service.
  • Deputy Manager (Security) requires the specified rank and at least 5 years of qualifying service.
  • Applicants must possess SHAPE-1 or equivalent medical fitness.
  • Age is calculated as on 31 October 2026.
  • Selection consists of an online written examination and interview, subject to SBI's right to modify the process.
  • There is no negative marking in the online written examination.
  • Professional Knowledge and interview scores determine final merit.
  • Application fees are non-refundable.
  • Call letters and recruitment updates will be communicated through SBI Careers and registered email.
  • Hard copies of applications should not be sent to SBI.
  • Selected candidates may be posted anywhere in India.

What Are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions. These commissions recruit candidates for various posts and services under state government departments according to the rules applicable to each recruitment.

State PSC recruitment is not limited to State Civil Services examinations. Public Service Commissions may also recruit candidates for engineering, medical, teaching, agriculture, legal, scientific, technical, administrative and other departmental posts.

The posts available depend on vacancies reported by the respective state government departments and the recruitment notifications issued by the commission.

Popular Posts Recruited Through State PSCs

State Public Service Commissions recruit candidates for a wide range of government posts. Common recruitment categories may include:

  • State Civil Services
  • Administrative Services
  • Assistant Commissioner
  • Assistant Director
  • Assistant Professor
  • Lecturer
  • Medical Officer
  • Veterinary Officer
  • Assistant Engineer
  • Assistant Executive Engineer
  • Agriculture Officer
  • Food Safety Officer
  • Drug Inspector
  • Scientific Officer
  • Law Officer
  • Labour Officer
  • Revenue-related Posts
  • Technical Officers
  • Departmental Officers

The actual posts available vary by commission and recruitment notification.

PSC Jobs by Group (Group 1, 2, 2A, 4 & Others)

Several State Public Service Commissions including TNPSC, APPSC, and TSPSC classify recruitment into numbered "Groups" based on post seniority, pay scale, and administrative responsibility. Understanding these groups helps candidates identify which exam to prepare for based on their qualification and career goals.

Group Typical Posts Minimum Qualification Selection Stages
Group 1 Deputy Collector, DSP, Assistant Commissioner, District Registrar Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains + Interview
Group 2 Assistant Section Officer, Tehsildar, Municipal Commissioner (Grade), Block Development Officer Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains (some states include Interview)
Group 2A Junior Assistant, Bill Collector, Field Surveyor Bachelor's degree Written Exam (Certificate Verification)
Group 3 Various department Grade II/Non-Gazetted posts Varies by post Written Exam
Group 4 Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno-Typist, Bill Collector, Record Clerk, Village Administrative Officer (VAO) SSLC / 10th or 12th pass (varies by post) Single Written Exam (Certificate Verification)

Group numbering, post names, and minimum qualifications vary by state the table above reflects the common pattern used by TNPSC-style classification. Some states use different group labels or don't use numbered groups at all. Always confirm the exact group structure and eligibility on your state PSC's official notification.

Who Should Apply for Group 4?

Group 4 posts are typically entry-level government jobs open to candidates who have completed SSLC (10th) or Higher Secondary (12th), making them one of the most accessible and high-demand categories of PSC recruitment. These posts don't usually require a specific degree, have a single-stage written exam, and see some of the highest applicant volumes of any PSC exam due to the lower qualification bar and large number of annual vacancies.

State PSC Eligibility Criteria

There is no single eligibility rule for all State PSC jobs. Qualification, age limit, experience and other conditions differ depending on the commission and post.

Eligibility Criteria General Guidance
Educational Qualification Depends on the post and may include Diploma, Graduation, Engineering, Medicine, Law, Post Graduation or another prescribed qualification.
Age Limit Minimum and maximum age limits vary by commission and recruitment.
Age Relaxation Relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the recruitment.
State / Domicile Conditions State-specific eligibility, reservation, language or residency conditions may apply to certain recruitments.
Experience Some technical, teaching, specialist or senior posts require relevant professional experience.
Number of Attempts Attempt restrictions apply only where specifically prescribed for an examination or recruitment.

Important: Candidates should check the detailed recruitment notification before applying because eligibility conditions differ for every State PSC recruitment.

State PSC Selection Process

The State PSC selection process depends on the commission and the type of post. There is no single selection procedure followed for every PSC recruitment.

Depending on the recruitment, the selection process may include one or more of the following stages:

  • Preliminary Examination
  • Main Examination
  • Written Examination
  • Screening Test
  • Subject-specific Examination
  • Skill Test
  • Physical Test
  • Interview / Personality Test
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

State Civil Services examinations may have Preliminary, Main and Interview stages, while technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitment may follow a different selection process.

Always check the individual recruitment notification for the exact examination and selection procedure.

How to Apply for State PSC Jobs 2026

The application process differs slightly between commissions, but candidates can generally follow these steps:

  1. Find the required State PSC recruitment from the latest jobs table above.
  2. Open the detailed recruitment page.
  3. Check the post name, vacancies, qualification, age limit, application fee and important dates.
  4. Read the official recruitment notification carefully.
  5. Open the official application website or application link.
  6. Complete registration or One-Time Registration if required by the commission.
  7. Enter the required personal, educational and category details.
  8. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  9. Pay the application fee if applicable.
  10. Review the application before final submission.
  11. Submit the application before the specified last date.
  12. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Candidates should submit applications only through the application method specified in the official notification.

State PSC Exam Pattern and Syllabus

There is no common exam pattern or syllabus for all State PSC recruitments.

State Civil Services examinations generally cover broader subjects such as General Studies and state-specific topics, while technical, medical, engineering, teaching and departmental recruitment may focus more heavily on subjects related to the post.

The following can differ between recruitments:

  • Number of papers
  • Objective or descriptive examination
  • Total marks
  • Exam duration
  • Negative marking
  • Minimum qualifying marks
  • Language requirements
  • Subject-specific syllabus
  • Interview or skill test requirements

Candidates should refer to the syllabus and exam pattern issued for the specific State PSC recruitment they are applying for.

State PSC Jobs vs UPSC Jobs

State Public Service Commissions and the Union Public Service Commission conduct different recruitment processes.

State PSC UPSC
Conducts recruitment for posts and services connected with the respective state. Conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.
Recruitment rules differ from one State PSC to another. Recruitment is conducted under the rules applicable to UPSC examinations and vacancies.
May recruit for State Civil Services, engineering, medical, teaching, technical and departmental posts. Conducts Civil Services Examination and various other recruitment examinations for Union Government posts.

Candidates looking for Union Government recruitment through UPSC can visit the UPSC Jobs page.

PSC vs PCS - What Is the Difference?

PSC stands for Public Service Commission. It refers to the constitutional commission responsible for conducting recruitment for various government posts and services within its jurisdiction.

PCS commonly refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services posts and examinations.

A State Public Service Commission may conduct a State Civil Services or PCS examination, but it can also conduct recruitment for many other positions such as Medical Officer, Assistant Engineer, Lecturer, Agriculture Officer and departmental posts.

Therefore, State PSC Jobs covers a broader range of recruitment than only PCS or State Civil Services examinations.

How to Choose the Right State PSC Recruitment

Before applying for a State PSC vacancy, candidates should compare the recruitment requirements with their qualification and preferences.

Check the following details:

  • Required educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Category and reservation conditions
  • State or language requirements, if any
  • Number of vacancies
  • Pay scale or salary
  • Job location
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Examination pattern
  • Application deadline

Apply only after confirming that you meet the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official recruitment notification.

State PSC Recruitment Updates You Should Check

A recruitment notification can sometimes be followed by additional notices from the commission. Candidates should continue checking recruitment updates even after submitting their application.

Important updates may include:

  • Application date extension

  • Vacancy revision

What are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC Jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions for various posts and services under state government departments.

Which State PSC jobs are currently open?

Where can I find the latest State PSC recruitment notifications?

You can check the latest State PSC recruitment notifications on this page or select your commission from the State-wise PSC Jobs section to find recruitment specific to your state.

What qualification is required for State PSC jobs?

There is no single qualification required for all State PSC jobs. Depending on the post, candidates may need a Diploma, Graduation, Engineering degree, Medical qualification, Law degree, Post Graduation or another specified qualification.

Are all State PSC jobs for graduates?

No. Eligibility depends on the individual recruitment. Many administrative posts require a degree, while technical, professional and departmental posts may have different qualification requirements.

What is the age limit for State PSC jobs?

The minimum and maximum age limits vary according to the commission and post. Candidates should check the age criteria given in the individual recruitment notification.

Is age relaxation available for State PSC recruitment?

Age relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the respective recruitment. The exact relaxation should be checked in the official notification.

Is domicile compulsory for State PSC jobs?

Not for every State PSC recruitment. Some vacancies may have state-specific residency, reservation, language or other eligibility requirements. Candidates should check the relevant recruitment rules before applying.

What is the selection process for State PSC jobs?

The selection process varies by post. It may include a Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, written test, screening test, skill test, interview, physical test, document verification or medical examination.

Do all State PSC recruitments have Prelims and Mains?

No. Prelims and Mains are common in some State Civil Services examinations, but many technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitments follow a different examination or selection process.

How can I apply for State PSC recruitment?

Open the required recruitment from the latest jobs table, read the eligibility and application details, check the official notification and use the official application link provided on the recruitment page.

What is the difference between State PSC and UPSC?

State PSCs conduct recruitment mainly for posts and services connected with their respective states, while UPSC conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.

Is PSC the same as PCS?

No. PSC means Public Service Commission, while PCS generally refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services. A State PSC can recruit for PCS as well as many other administrative, technical, medical and departmental posts.

Where can I check State PSC admit cards?

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Forest Guard Recruitment 2026 - Latest Vacancies & Eligibility

Forest Guard recruitment is suitable for candidates interested in forest protection, patrolling and field-level government work. Forest Guard vacancies are generally announced by state forest departments or authorized recruitment boards.

What does a Forest Guard do?

A Forest Guard helps protect forest areas, monitor activities, assist with wildlife conservation and report suspected forest offences. Duties can include patrolling assigned forest areas and supporting senior forest officials.

What is the qualification for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Some Forest Guard recruitments require Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications from a recognized board. However, the exact educational requirements depend on the state and recruitment notification.

Candidates should check:

  • Education: Required qualification and recognized board.
  • Age Limit: Minimum and maximum age, including the age-calculation date.
  • Physical Standards: Height, chest measurements or other applicable requirements.
  • Selection Process: Written examination, physical tests or other notified stages.
  • Vacancies: Total and category-wise posts.
  • Application Dates: Registration opening and closing dates.

How can I apply for Forest Guard Vacancy 2026?

Find the Forest Guard recruitment in the vacancy table above, open the detailed notification, confirm eligibility and follow the official application instructions.

Candidates should apply only through the website or submission method prescribed by the recruiting authority.

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 - RFO Jobs

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 provides opportunities for candidates interested in forest administration, conservation and supervisory roles.

A Forest Range Officer, also referred to as a Range Forest Officer or RFO in some recruitment systems, may oversee forest protection activities, supervise field staff and manage responsibilities within an assigned forest range.

What is the qualification for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Forest Range Officer recruitment generally involves graduate-level eligibility. Some notifications require degrees in specified subjects such as science, agriculture, forestry or other approved disciplines.

The accepted qualifications vary by recruiting organization. A graduation degree alone does not automatically make a candidate eligible for every RFO vacancy.

How are Forest Range Officers selected?

Depending on the recruitment rules, selection may include:

  • Preliminary or main written examinations
  • Physical standards or fitness assessments
  • Interviews, where prescribed
  • Document verification
  • Medical examination

Candidates searching for RFO Vacancy 2026, Forest Ranger Recruitment or Forest Range Service Officer notifications should check the relevant vacancy details for exact eligibility and selection stages.

Note: Apprenticeship posts (under the Apprentices Act) are not regular government jobs but are a popular no-exam entry route into PSUs and railways for ITI/diploma/graduate candidates, offering valuable hands-on experience.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Checking a OnlyJobs result takes only a few minutes once you know the steps:

  • Find your exam in the Latest Results section below, or use the search bar to type the exam name (e.g., "SSC CGL" or "RRB NTPC").
  • Read the result summary to confirm the post, organisation, and result date.
  • Open the official portal link provided in the article (e.g., ssc.nic.in, upsc.gov.in).
  • Enter your Roll Number or Registration ID along with your date of birth, as required by that exam body.
  • Download or screenshot your result/scorecard for future reference - most government portals remove results after a few weeks.
  • Check the next stage (cut-off, document verification, interview call letter) - OnlyJobs lists this under the same exam tag so you can track the full recruitment cycle.

What is OnlyJobs?

OnlyJobs is a trusted Indian job and exam information portal. Find latest sarkari job vacancies, exam results, admit cards, online forms at OnlyJobs.

No. OnlyJobs is a private information portal, not a government website. All results, admit cards, and notifications link to their respective official government portals such as ssc.nic.in, upsc.gov.in, rrbcdg.gov.in, and ibps.in. OnlyJobs has been providing this aggregation service since 2011.

Download the OnlyJobs mobile app from Store, join the official WhatsApp Channel, or subscribe to the Telegram group. You will receive instant push notifications whenever a new result, admit card, or recruitment notification is published.

What's the difference between OnlyJobs and OnlyJobs Result?

"OnlyJobs" generally refers to the final outcome of a government recruitment (selection lists, scorecards), while "OnlyJobs Result" can also include preliminary/stage-wise outcomes like Prelims or Tier-1 results. OnlyJobs covers both under each exam's dedicated page.

The IBPS RRB Clerk PET Admit Card 2026 has been released on 26 November 2026 by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) for Office Assistant (Multipurpose) candidates under the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks (CRP RRBs-XV). Candidates who opted for Pre-Examination Training (PET) during registration and have been allotted the facility can download their PET call letters through the official website at ibps.in. The training is scheduled from 26 November to 1 December 2026.

The IBPS RRB Office Assistant PET Call Letter 2026 is available through the official candidate login using the Registration Number and Password or Date of Birth. Candidates must also complete the captcha verification. Pre-Examination Training is provided to help eligible candidates become familiar with the examination process before the preliminary examination scheduled for 6, 12 and 13 December 2026. The PET call letter is separate from the actual IBPS RRB Clerk Prelims Admit Card, which will be issued through a different download facility.

Candidates can follow these steps to download their IBPS RRB Office Assistant PET Call Letter 2026.

  1. Visit the official website at ibps.in.

What Is IBPS RRB Clerk Pre-Examination Training 2026?

Pre-Examination Training, commonly known as PET, is a preparatory facility provided to eligible candidates before the IBPS RRB recruitment examination.

The training is intended to familiarise candidates with the online examination process and provide general guidance about the test environment.

PET is available to candidates who satisfy the applicable eligibility conditions and opted for the facility during the application process.

The training does not replace the Preliminary Examination or guarantee selection in Regional Rural Banks.

Who Can Download IBPS RRB Clerk PET Call Letter 2026?

The PET call letter is intended for eligible Office Assistant (Multipurpose) candidates who selected the Pre-Examination Training option during registration and have been allotted the facility.

The training is offered according to the applicable IBPS recruitment conditions, including provisions for eligible candidates from specified reserved and other notified categories.

Candidates who did not opt for PET or were not allotted the facility should not assume they are eligible to access a PET call letter.

The PET facility is separate from the actual selection examinations.

Candidates facing difficulty accessing the PET portal should verify that they are using the official IBPS login link.

They should enter their Registration Number, Password or Date of Birth and captcha code correctly.

If the portal displays a browser-related error, candidates should use a compatible updated browser and try accessing the login page again.

Applicants should use the official IBPS support channels for unresolved technical issues. Personal passwords and other login credentials should not be shared with third parties.

IBPS RRB Clerk Selection Process 2026

The IBPS RRB Office Assistant (Multipurpose) recruitment is conducted through the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks.

The principal selection stages are:

  1. Preliminary Examination: Candidates appear in the online preliminary test.
  2. Main Examination: Candidates qualifying in the preliminary examination become eligible for the main examination according to IBPS shortlisting rules.
  3. Provisional Allotment: Eligible candidates are considered according to the applicable merit, vacancy and recruitment requirements.

There is no interview stage for the Office Assistant (Multipurpose) recruitment. PET is an optional preparatory facility for eligible allotted candidates and is not a separate selection examination.

  • Check the official IBPS website for the separate Prelims call-letter announcement.

About DDSCBL

The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is a state co-operative bank licensed by the RBI (Licence No. Dos. RO (AH). REG/LIC.S-2187/04.36.000/2023-24 dated 07 March 2024). Its Head Office is in Dilip Nagar, Nani Daman, and its Administration Department issued this notice. You can reach that department on 0260 2255984 and 2255985, or by email at [email protected]. The internship is part of NABARD's scheme for engaging Cooperative Interns to strengthen cooperatives. The National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) runs the scheme, NABARD monitors it and state co-operative banks carry it out.

DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Vacancy Details 2026

Cooperative Intern (Diu District)1Rs.25,000 per month (consolidated)

The bank pays TA/DA from its own funds. The Rs.25,000 remuneration is reimbursed from the Cooperative Education Fund of the Ministry of Cooperation through NCDC.

Age Limit

You must be at least 21 years old and no older than 30.

Educational Qualification

  • MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management / Cooperative Management / Agri Business Management / Rural Development Management.
  • Essential: proficiency in computer.

The bank asks candidates to read the full eligibility criteria and essential requirements in NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024, which comes with the official notification, before applying.

Duties of the Cooperative Intern

  • Work with PACS and other primary cooperatives and guide them in carrying out the initiatives of the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India.
  • Solve day-to-day problems PACS face with computerisation, business plans, projects, financing and various approvals.
  • Prepare and share a weekly status report on these initiatives, in coordination with the DCCB/StCB.

The scheme aims to take the cooperative movement down to the grassroots. It also lets professional graduates learn how cooperatives work in practice and builds a pool of experienced cooperative professionals.

  • Understand customer financial goals and investment requirements.
  • Promote suitable mutual fund, insurance, portfolio management and other investment products.
  • Conduct customer portfolio reviews and financial planning discussions.
  • Support business development and customer retention.
  • Maintain customer service, documentation and regulatory compliance standards.

Uttarakhand Gramin Bank (UGB), Dehradun has invited applications from retired officers of Scale III to Scale V of UGB, SBI, any other RRB sponsored by SBI or any commercial bank for 10 Concurrent Auditor posts on contract for up to 12 months. Applications are sent by post or delivered by hand to The General Manager (Administration) at the Head Office in Dehradun. The last date for submission at that address is 15 December 2026.

UGB Concurrent Auditor at a Glance

The official notification does not specify the application fee.

About the Bank

Uttarakhand Gramin Bank is a bank with its Head Office at 8 A, IT Park, Dehradun. The Concurrent Audit is to be conducted in selected branches, AMSHs and CPCs in and around ten centres. The selected auditors will form a pool available with the Chief Inspector at Head Office, who allocates the auditee units and gives the necessary instructions.

Where and How to Send

Download the application from the Bank's website www.ukgb.bank.in. The application format is also printed in the notice. Send it by post or deliver it by hand to:

The General Manager (Administration), Uttarakhand Gramin Bank, Head Office – 8 A, IT PARK, Opposite SIDCUL, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun - 248 013

The last date for submission at this address is 15.12.2026. Applications received after the last date will not be entertained. The notice does not mention an envelope superscription, a postal mode or an application email address.

The application asks for these details:

  • Name, father's name and date of birth.
  • Bank and branch office from which the applicant retired, the post/scale held at retirement, and the date of retirement. A certificate in Annexure – A is required if the applicant did not retire from Uttarakhand Gramin Bank.
  • PF No./Employee No., present residence with full postal address, permanent address, mobile/landline number and email ID.
  • Educational qualification and JAIIB/CAIIB status.
  • Details of the last 3 postings before retirement with dates.
  • Experience in loans, audit or NPA follow-up, current work if any, and any disciplinary action during service.
  • KYC details (Aadhaar No. and PAN No.), the period of medical leave in the year before retirement, and the full address of the usual place of residence if empanelled.
  • Experience as Regional Manager or Branch Manager in years and months.

The applicant also states that he or she agrees to work anywhere in the Bank's area of operation, and declares that the information is true, failing which the candidature may be cancelled.

  • The applicant must be a retired (superannuated) officer of Scale III to Scale V from UGB, SBI, any other RRB sponsored by SBI or any commercial bank. Officers going to superannuate within the next 6 months can also apply.
  • Experience: minimum 2 years of Branch Manager/Regional Manager assignment with a satisfactory track record, and good experience in operation, preferably from an Audit background.
  • Age: below 69 years at the time of renewal of the contract.
  • The gap from the date of superannuation to the date of first appointment must not be more than 2 years. For later renewals there should not be a gap of one year.
  • The officer must never have been penalised in disciplinary proceedings while in active service, except punishment by way of censure.
  • The officer must be medically fit, certified by the sponsor Bank's doctor with all normal pathological tests, and fluent in both Hindi and English.
  • Those on medical leave exceeding four months in the last year of service are not eligible to apply.

The notice does not name any educational qualification. The official notification should be checked for the eligibility details of the post.

Remuneration

  • Home-centre: a fixed sum of Rs 40,000 per month. The auditor may claim reimbursement of travelling expenses not exceeding Rs 4,000 per month on the basis of a certificate or petrol bill.

It records the retirement date and scale, years as Branch Manager/Regional Manager and as an Auditor, any major penalty, and the days of medical leave in the last year of service.

  • The successful candidate signs an Agreement and must pay the required stamp duty as per Stamp laws in force in Uttarakhand.

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has officially released the RRB ALP Score Card 2026 on 12th June 2026. Candidates who appeared in the Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) Computer Based Test Stage 1, conducted on 13th, 16th, 17th, and 18th February 2026 under CEN 01/2025, can now log in to the official RRB portal to view and download their individual scorecards. The scorecard displays raw marks, normalized marks, total questions attempted, and the final qualifying status for CBT 2. Candidates must note that the scorecard viewing window closes on 27th June 2026, so early download is strongly advised.

RRB ALP Score Card 2026 - Key Highlights

This section provides a quick-reference overview of all essential details related to the RRB ALP CBT 1 Score Card 2026, including exam dates, login credentials required, and what the scorecard contains.

How to Download RRB ALP CBT 1 Score Card 2026

Downloading your RRB ALP Score Card 2026 is a simple process that takes just a few minutes. Candidates need their Registration Number and Date of Birth to access the portal. Follow these steps carefully to download your scorecard without any trouble.

Follow the steps below to access and download the RRB ALP Score Card 2026:

  1. Visit the official website of your regional Railway Recruitment Board.
  2. Click on the link titled "RRB ALP Scorecard 2026."
  3. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  4. Solve the security Captcha displayed on the screen.
  5. Click the "Login" or "Submit" button.
  6. Your scorecard will appear on the screen download and take a printout of it.

Pro Tip: Save a digital copy of the scorecard on your device and keep at least 2 printed copies ready for the document verification stage.

RRB ALP Score Card 2026 - Official Download Link

The official download link for the RRB ALP CBT 1 Score Card 2026 is now active across all railway zones. Candidates must click on the link corresponding to the region they applied under to view their individual results. Candidates can also access the scorecard through the centralized Indian Railways portal at indianrailways.gov.in or through the specific regional RRB website for their zone.

What Information Is Available on the RRB ALP CBT 1 Score Card 2026?

Understanding what your scorecard contains will help you verify its accuracy and plan your next steps. The RRB ALP CBT 1 Score Card 2026 includes both personal and performance-related details.

When you receive the score card, verify the following information for accuracy:

  • Candidate Details: The candidate's full name and the RRB zone applied for.
  • Registration Number: The unique ID assigned during the application process.
  • Total Questions: Number of questions in the paper and how many were ignored, if any.
  • Raw Score: Marks calculated based on correct and incorrect responses.
  • Normalized Marks: The final score after adjusting for shift-wise difficulty level.
  • Shortlisted Status: A clear "Yes" or "No" indicating qualification for CBT 2. 

The normalized score is the most important figure it is this score that determines the candidate's rank in the merit list, not the raw marks.

The minimum qualifying percentage is different from the final CBT cut-off required for shortlisting to PET. The category-wise minimum qualifying percentages for RRB Group D are given below.

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks

Securing the minimum qualifying percentage does not guarantee selection for PET. Candidates must also meet the applicable category-wise and zone-wise cut-off and be included in the official shortlist.

How to Check RRB Group D Cut Off 2026?

Candidates can check the RRB Group D CBT cut-off marks through their respective regional Railway Recruitment Board websites by following these steps.

  1. Visit the official website of your respective Railway Recruitment Board.
  2. Open the CEN 09/2025 Level-1 recruitment section.
  3. Find the RRB Group D CBT Result and Cut Off 2026 notification.
  4. Click on the category-wise cut-off marks PDF link.
  5. Download the official cut-off document.
  6. Find your category and applicable railway region.
  7. Check the normalised cut-off marks and compare them with your scorecard.
  8. Save the cut-off PDF for future reference.

Factors Affecting RRB Group D Cut Off 2026

The RRB Group D CBT cut-off varies across recruitment regions and categories. Important factors affecting the cut-off include:

  • Number of vacancies available in the respective railway region
  • Number of candidates appearing for the CBT examination
  • Difficulty level of the examination
  • Normalisation of marks across different examination shifts
  • Category-wise reservation and shortlisting requirements

RRB Group D Normalised Marks 2026

The RRB Group D CBT was conducted in multiple shifts. Normalisation is used to account for differences in examination difficulty across shifts.

The published cut-off scores are normalised marks. Candidates should compare their applicable normalised score with the cut-off for their railway region and category, rather than relying only on their estimated raw marks.

What After RRB Group D Cut Off 2026?

Candidates shortlisted through the RRB Group D CBT result will proceed to the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Those who qualify in PET will be considered for further recruitment stages as per the official selection procedure.

The recruitment stages include:

  1. Computer-Based Test (CBT)
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
  3. Document Verification
  4. Medical Examination

The PET schedule and detailed instructions will be announced separately by the railway recruitment authorities.

Update 11 Nov 2026: The last date to apply has been extended to 10 December 2026. See the notice

Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (UPMRC) has released the recruitment notification UPMRC/HR/D/2/2026 for 1 Project Director post on a deputation basis. The notified pay scale for the post is Rs. 1,50,000- 3,00,000, with a normal tenure of deputation for a period of 3 years, which may be extendable. Eligible candidates holding a B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent from Government recognized University/Institute can apply. Applicants should submit their offline application by Speed post/By hand/Proper channel to Manager (HR) Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building on or before 10 December 2026. The selection process consists of shortlisting of candidates for interview followed by an interview.

UPMRC Project Director at a Glance

Particulars Details
Organisation Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (UPMRC)
Department or Unit Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited
Project Kanpur & Agra Metro Projects Phase 1B of the Lucknow Metro project
Post Project Director
Vacancies 1 (One) / Kanpur
Pay Rs. 1,50,000- 3,00,000 on Absorption basis, or Parent pay plus deputation allowance on Deputation basis
Contract Term Normal tenure of deputation for a period of 3 years, which may be extendable
Experience Required Minimum of five (5) years' experience in Planning / Construction, tendering and executing multi-disciplinary/ large infrastructure projects of Metro/ Railways
Job Location Kanpur (with liability to be posted at any of the project sites/ offices at any location of UPMRC projects)
How to Apply Offline (by Speed post/By hand/Proper channel)
Last Date 10 December 2026 (30 days from the date of notification of vacancy)
Selection Shortlisting of candidates for interview followed by interview

Who Can Apply

Candidates must fulfill the following educational qualification, experience, and age criteria to be eligible for the Project Director post:

  • Educational Qualification: B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent from Government recognized University/Institute.
  • Service Requirement (Option 1): The applicant should be working for atleast two years in SAG or an equivalent grade in the pay scale of Rs. 1,20,000-2,80,000 (IDA) or Rs. 1,44,200 - 2,18,200/Level-14 of 7th CPC Pay matrix (CDA) in Government organisations/ Government Metro companies, with proven track record of a minimum of twenty (20) years of service at Group A / Executive Level.
  • Service Requirement (Option 2): An applicant who is presently working in CDA/IDA pay scales in Government Organisations/ Government Metro Companies and has previously worked in the Private sector, his services in executive in reputed Private sector will also be considered for computing the requisite twenty (20) years of executive level service. In this regard, the applicant should submit necessary documents in support of executive level experience.
  • Eligible Work Experience: The candidate should have a minimum of five (5) years' experience in Planning/ Construction, tendering and executing multi-disciplinary/ large infrastructure projects of Metro/ Railways.
  • Age Limit: Max. 57 years as on the last date of vacancy notification (10/12/2026).

Desirable Work Experience

  • Experience in underground Metro constructions including tunnels.
  • Experience of all phases of project of internationally funded contracts i.e. planning, tender document preparation, bidding, execution, commissioning, post-commissioning etc.
  • Experience and knowledge of complying with project related requirements of international funding institutions.
  • Experience and knowledge of coordinating and interfacing with Railway related disciplines such as track installation, signaling, electrification and rolling stock etc.
  • Experience and knowledge of safety aspects relating to railway construction including clearance and certification from Commissioner of Railway Safety (CMRS).

Pay and Terms

The scale of pay is Rs. 1,50,000- 3,00,000 on Absorption basis. On Deputation basis, the selected candidate will receive Parent pay plus deputation allowance. The normal tenure of deputation is for a period of 3 years, which may be extendable. Applicants chosen on absorption basis will execute a Surety bond of Rs. 3,00,000/- to serve the Corporation for a minimum period of three years (exclusive of the period in which one remained in LWP or EOL) and provide three months prior notice before seeking resignation. Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of two years (including the period of training).

UPMRC Project Director Job Description

The incumbent of the post shall be responsible for the following duties and responsibilities:

  • Overall Project Management for all civil construction activities including safety and quality control, planning, scheduling, monitoring and controlling of preliminary and final designs, tendering, track works, contract administration and commissioning.
  • Project monitoring, interface management, quality assurance and safety, cost control of works for the project.
  • Land acquisition, rehabilitation of project affected persons/ businesses, utility and traffic diversions etc required for construction of the Metro Project.
  • Arranging necessary clearances and statutory approvals for implementation of project during construction and commissioning.

How to Apply for UPMRC Project Director

Candidates can apply for the position by following these steps:

  1. Download the prescribed proforma for submission of application from the official notification PDF.
  2. Fill out all required details in the application form accurately.
  3. Attach all required educational certificates, work experience certificates, APARs for the last 04 years, and D&AR/Vigilance clearance.
  4. For candidates applying through proper channel, ensure the application is forwarded through their parent organization with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance.
  5. Send the completed hard copy of the application along with supporting documents by post or by hand to the following address: Manager (HR) Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomti nagar, Lucknow-226010.
  6. Applicants may send an advance copy of the application with all supporting documents via email to [email protected], but sending the hard copy of the application is mandatory.

Selection Process

Eligible candidates will be called for an interview at Lucknow. Selection is based on Interview basis. The Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview.

UPMRC Project Director Important Instructions

  • Cutoff date for age and eligibility criteria is reckoned as on the last date of notification of vacancy (10 December 2026).
  • The applicant must be physically and medically fit as per Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM).
  • Applications received after closing date and time or incomplete applications will not be entertained.
  • UPMRC will not be responsible for postal delays or wrong delivery.
  • All candidates called for interview shall not be paid any travelling allowance by UPMRC.

Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways can attend a walk-in interview on 8 December 2026 (Tuesday), reporting between 10.00 hrs and 12.00 hrs, at DFCCIL/Corporate Office, DFCCIL Complex, Near Sector 146 Metro Station, Sector-145, Noida UP- 201306. Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL), a Government of India (Ministry of Railways) Enterprise, has issued Advt. No. 30/2026 to form a need-based panel for re-employment against 4 posts in its OP&BD department – 2 posts of JGM (OP&BD) and 2 posts of DGM (OP&BD). The pay is fixed in terms of DFCCIL's HR Policy.

DFCCIL Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue

ParticularsDetails
Walk-in Date08.12.2026 (Tuesday)
Reporting Time10.00 hrs. to 12.00 hrs.

Who Can AttendRetired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-13 (JGM) or Pay Level-12 (DGM)

The official notification does not specify the application fee or a minimum educational qualification.

About DFCCIL

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited is a Government of India (Ministry of Railways) Enterprise, described in the notice as an infrastructure initiative undertaken by Indian Railways to modernize freight transportation. It is creating high capacity, high speed, freight only rail corridors. This walk-in is for need-based re-employment of retired government employees of Indian Railways in the OP&BD department of DFCCIL.

Posts and Eligibility

The notice gives each post's eligibility by the pay level from which the officer retired, together with the place of posting of each post.

PostVacanciesWho Can ApplyPlace of Posting
JGM (OP&BD)2Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-13OCC/ADI – 1 post; OCC/PRYJ – 1 post
DGM (OP&BD)2Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-12Noida unit – 1 post; Mumbai unit – 1 post

Only the substantive/regular pay level/grade pay is considered. The MACP pay level/grade pay held at the time of retirement is not considered. The empanelment follows the eligibility criteria of HR Policy No. 28/2022 dated 22.07.2022 and 07/2026 dated 29.01.2026, based on the level from which the employee retired; in the attached policy table, Level-13 matches JGM (E6) and Level-12 matches DGM (E5).

The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-wise eligibility of each post.

Age Limit

Under the HR policy, re-employed employees are allowed to work up to the maximum age limit of 65 years. On the date of walk-in interview, the age of retired employees should not exceed 64 years, that is, on the date of advertisement one year of residual age to attain 65 years should remain available. Preference will be given to retired employees from Indian Railways with good health.

Pay and Allowances

PostPay
JGM (OP&BD), DGM (OP&BD)Fixed in terms of HR Policy; the attached Circular No. 28/2022 gives monthly remuneration @50% of last Basic Pay drawn plus applicable DA for re-employed retired employees

Conveyance allowance and mobile charges are governed by DFCCIL's policy, and no other allowance is admissible. In the attached circular, the re-employed post band "Manager (E-4) and above" gets conveyance charges of Rs. 4000/2000 per month (the lower figure if posted in cities other than Hyderabad, Delhi, Bangalore, Greater Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Surat, Nagpur, Pune, Jaipur, Lucknow and Kanpur urban agglomerations) and mobile charges of Rs. 500/- per month. For travel on duty, TA/DA/lodging is admissible as per the extant HR policy.

Tenure and Leave

  • Selected candidates are placed on a panel and re-employed/deployed based on requirement, initially for one year.
  • The period can be extended as per the requirements/performance of the retired employee, at the sole discretion of DFCCIL.
  • The re-employment can be terminated prematurely on one month's notice by either side.
  • Two days leave is granted for each completed month of contract, without a name such as CL or Earned Leave; accumulated leave cannot be carried forward to the next calendar year.
  • Deployment of selected employees will be made as per administrative/operational requirement.

Who Will Not Be Considered

  • Retired employees who earlier worked in DFCCIL in any capacity but were terminated from service for any reason, or were not granted extension of re-employment.
  • Persons borne on the current "Agreed/Secret" list while in service, involved in any current Vigilance/CBI case, or against whom disciplinary proceedings or prosecution are in process.
  • Persons imposed a major penalty, or two or more minor penalties, or against whom administrative action was taken three times or more, or who were imposed one minor penalty and two administrative actions as a result of Vigilance/CBI action while in service on Railways.
  • Persons against whom a minor penalty was imposed or administrative action taken as a result of Vigilance/CBI action during the last 5 years of service (for retired officers).

What to Bring

Candidates must bring the duly filled prescribed proforma attached to the notice – the Application Form (for Retired Employees), the Working Experience proforma, the Verification Form and the Declaration regarding D&AR/Vigilance Status – with the following:

  • Self-attested photocopies of PPO (as per 7th CPC) and Service Certificate
  • Last Pay Slip
  • Aadhar card
  • Cancelled cheque or copy of bank passbook
  • Two recent passport size photographs (one self-attested on the application form, one attested on the verification form)
  • Proof of identity and residence
  • Original Service Certificate/PPO and other documents for verification
  • Copy of complete bio-data, PPO no., PPF no., PAN no. and complete bank account details with IFSC code, as asked in the application form

Candidates who do not bring the documents on the date of interview will not be allowed for the interview.

What Happens on the Day

  1. Report at the DFCCIL Corporate Office, Noida, between 10.00 hrs and 12.00 hrs on 8 December 2026.
  2. DFCCIL officials check the applications; only those who meet the criteria of the advertisement and produce the Service Certificate/PPO (as per 7th CPC) and other relevant documents are allowed for interview.
  3. The walk-in interview is held to form a panel for the posts on re-employment basis. The attached policy says a committee of three members of GGM/GM/CGM level, constituted with the approval of the MD, selects re-employed officials, with marks out of 40 for domain knowledge and personality and qualifying marks of 60% out of 40.
  4. Selected candidates are issued an offer of appointment as per requirement.
  5. They must undergo a medical examination/health check-up and are re-employed only if found medically fit, in addition to fulfilling other criteria.

The attached policy also says that after orders for re-employment are issued, the verification form is sent for police verification; an adverse report leads to immediate termination and refund of remuneration paid.

Important Instructions

  • No TA/DA/journey expense is paid for appearing in the interview; candidates should arrange travel and stay in advance.
  • Wilful suppression of any material fact leads to summary rejection of candidature, and the candidate will not be interviewed.
  • Under the declaration, no payment is made until vigilance clearance is received, and services end without notice if anything adverse is found.
  • Furnishing false information in the form is a disqualification; if found during engagement, the contract is terminated and remuneration paid must be refunded.
  • The re-employment will not confer any right for regularization in DFCCIL.
  • Any dispute regarding this advertisement is under the jurisdiction of Court in Delhi only.

How to Calculate Your Expected SBI PO Prelims Score

Expected Score = (Correct Answers x 1) - (Wrong Answers x 0.25)

How to Check Answers Using UPSC CGS Answer Key 2026?

Candidates can compare the answer keys with their question papers to review the answers accepted by UPSC during the examination evaluation.

The answer-key release on 4 November 2026 is a later update and does not represent a new Preliminary Examination result.

UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Final Result 2026

The UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Final Result 2026 was declared on 16 October 2026. The recruitment process included the Preliminary Examination, Main Examination and Personality Test.

UPSC subsequently published cut-off marks on 21 October 2026 and marks of recommended candidates on 30 October 2026.

Therefore, the answer keys issued on 4 November 2026 relate to an examination cycle for which the final recruitment result had already been declared.

These documents do not announce a new objection window, objection fee or representation deadline.

Candidates should not treat the publication of these post-result answer keys as the opening of a fresh answer-key challenge facility.

Important Instructions for UPSC Geo-Scientist Candidates

Candidates checking the Combined Geo-Scientist Examination answer keys should carefully verify the subject, paper and series before reviewing the published answers.

  • Choose General Studies Paper I or the correct Paper II subject.
  • Verify the question-paper series.
  • Compare answers using the question numbers printed in the PDF.
  • Check the maximum marks and dropped-question information.
  • Use the official examination rules when calculating scores.
  • Consult UPSC's already published results and marks for official performance information.

UPSC CMS 2026 Marking Scheme

  • One-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for a wrong answer.

  • A question left blank/unattempted carries no penalty.

UPSC accepts representations against the question paper and provisional answer keys only through its official online portal no email, post, or in-person submissions are entertained.

  2. Go to "Examinations" and select "Representations on Question Paper & Provisional Answer Keys."
  3. Choose the relevant question, paper, and reason for objection.
  4. Submit supporting justification where the portal allows it.
  5. Submit before the window closes  6:00 PM on the 7th day from the exam date. Nothing is entertained after this deadline.

Post Name  Educational Qualification
Management Trainee (Commercial & Operations)
  • Candidates must have a Graduate with (55% Marks) and 02 Years MBA or Equivalent PG Degree or Diploma with specialization in Marketing/ International Business/ Operations/ Logistics/ Supply Chain Management with (60% Marks).

  • Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering in Mechanical / Electrical/ Electronics with (60% Marks).

  • Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering with (60% Marks).

  • Candidates must have a Graduate with (55% Marks) and 02 Years MBA/MSW or Equivalent PG Degree or Diploma with specialization in HRM/ Personnel Management/ Industrial Relations with (60% Marks).
Assistant Officer (Commercial & Operations)
  • Candidates must have a Graduate with (50% Marks) and 04 Years Experience OR 2 Years (for candidates having Institute of Rail Transport Diploma in multi modal transport or any other special course of minimum one year in shipping/logistics/ Trade along with qualification as mentioned above).
Assistant Officer (Accounts)
  • Candidates must have a B. Com with (50% Marks) and 04 Years Experience OR 2 Years (for candidates qualified in CA(Inter)/CMA (Inter) along with qualification as mentioned above.
Assistant Officer (Technical)
  • Candidates must have a Diploma/Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical/ Electrical/ Electronics with (50% Marks) and 3 Years Experience for candidates having diploma OR 1 Year (for candidates having Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering in Mechanical/ Electrical/Civil/Electronics with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from any university or institute duly approved by Govt / recognized by AICTE/ UGC).
Assistant Officer (MIS)
  • Candidates must have a Graduate with PGDCA or BCA or B.Sc (Hons) in Computer Science or DOEACC ‘A’ Level with (50% Marks) and 3 Years Experience (in IT support, software applications in reputed company), OR 1 Year (for candidates having MCA Degree/B.Tech/ BE (Computer Science/Computer Engg.)/ M.Sc (IT)/ M.Sc (Computer Science)/ DOEACC B level with minimum 50% marks).
Assistant Officer (Civil)
  • Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering with (50% Marks) and 1 Year Experience for candidates having Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering & 3 Years for candidates having Diploma in Civil Engineering.
